Do not invent a global shortcut that conflicts with composing. Return focus to the original trigger or insertion point. A slow prior search response cannot replace a newer result set or steal focus. Screen readers receive one relevant result/update announcement, not repeated full-list narration. Opening the public Page uses safe external-link handling and does not leak a private conversation URL as referrer/context.

On a phone, Search → Preview → Insert/Back is one stack. Back restores query/filter/scroll; closing restores the draft. Do not require precision hover or a modifier key to preview. Reflow and zoom must leave primary actions reachable without two-dimensional page scrolling. Respect reduced motion. Lazy-load public media and cancel obsolete preview/search requests; text remains useful on a slow connection. Do not introduce offline article downloads or persist sensitive preview/draft context beyond existing owner rules.

### REQ26-D27-DATA_CONTRACT-S0003 — Authoritative ownership

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Fact                                                                                                     | Authority                                                    | D27 use and invariant                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tenant, actor, membership/capability, current Support access                                             | Core identity/access and owning domain policy                | Derive from trusted request/server context. Catalog visibility, curation, CMS editing and CRM access are separate capabilities.                                       |
| Page identity/body/summary/title/version/editorial language/publication                                  | Web Studio/Payload content owner                             | Reference exact Page/Site/locale lineage. No operational body copy, reverse sync, shared editor or cross-schema FK.                                                   |
| Public generation, reach, canonical URL, same-source route continuity, domain control and current safety | P23/P24/public runtime owners                                | Public flag/preview/HTTP-200 is insufficient. Current owner proof decides eligibility; no URL crawler or client-built path.                                           |
| Active/Removed Guidance selection and transition history                                                 | Support, through its existing management capability          | One current selection per tenant/exact source variant, generations and durable receipt; does not publish or approve each article revision.                            |
| Search document/snippet/ranking/cache                                                                    | Shared public search/read owner; derived                     | Qualified selected corpus and current public heads before hits/counts/snippets. Shared-by-link participation is staff-specific and does not broaden public discovery. |
| Current reply/note private draft and intentional editor action                                           | Existing Support/D23/P17 purpose-qualified document boundary | One actual draft through Support and CRM; no new composer or whole-Page insertion.                                                                                    |
| Guidance link occurrence                                                                                 | Existing typed document and P17 source dependency            | Frozen label/href plus minimal trusted source qualification; no attached article body. History is not reconstructed from the current Page.                            |
| Prepared email bytes/signature/source material and safety fences                                         | Email Studio/P17                                             | Existing immutable preparation and material contract; narrow new source-reference family, not another renderer/policy engine.                                         |
| Send admission / provider submission, retries and uncertain success                                      | Support admission / P6 delivery                              | Current authorized admission and atomic fence/submission rules. No live CMS read/rerender after seal; possible external success reconciles.                           |
| Party, relationships, CRM correspondence and giving/contact actions                                      | CRM and respective business owners                           | Lookup/insertion creates no Party/activity/last-contact/gift/receipt change and grants no extra access.                                                               |

### REQ26-D27-DATA_CONTRACT-S0004 — Logical data constraints

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

**Guidance selection:** stable local selection identity; non-null tenant; qualified source namespace/Site/Page/locale; Active/Removed intent; monotone current generation; trusted created/changed attribution; durable transition receipt. Enforce unique logical source variant per tenant rather than permitting duplicate active rows. Re-add is a new transition, not a new duplicate. Keep source identity immutable within a selection; replacing a source is explicit removal/addition. Preserve CMS numeric/string identifier semantics and existing Support TEXT IDs where used, rather than forcing UUID conversion.

Tenant-aware operational relationships require composite tenant qualification and supporting indexes. A curator's account removal must not cascade away selection/audit history or revive authorization. CMS deletion leaves an unavailable qualified soft reference/tombstone under owner retention, not a cascading operational delete or title-based relink. Tenant teardown follows existing domain deletion/custody requirements, including finite message-derived provenance; “append-only audit” is not permission to retain all content forever.

Source publication, derived eligibility and last proof are not client-writable authorizations. A cached `isPublic` boolean, public URL or last successful resolution cannot grant future use. Source receipts/epochs are qualified by the owner and carry only the minimum identity/generation/disposition needed by current contracts. New table names, fixed sizes, global article IDs and a universal reference registry are not mandated.

**Command boundary:** current authenticated capability plus expected selection generation plus idempotency key/payload digest → one atomic intent/history/receipt/required-continuation write. If a response is lost, query the existing receipt. If the same key carries a different payload, conflict; if source/selection generation is stale, requalify/review rather than overwriting another curator. Source proof is obtained through the owner; an operational commit does not write to Payload in the same transaction. Current source/adverse heads prevent a source that changed during selection from being returned as eligible.

### REQ26-D27-DATA_CONTRACT-S0005 — Grants, RLS and protected fields

Applies to **US26-D27-06**, acceptance **AC26-D27-06-01–03**.

The exposed operational model must deny anonymous catalog administration and unauthorized tenant/member access. Distinguish effective SQL grants, RLS row eligibility, column mutation privileges and the authoritative domain command. Test actual allowed reads and denials; an empty result is not proof of authorization correctness.

For mutations verify both existing-row USING and resulting-row WITH CHECK semantics. PostgreSQL 17 can reuse USING when WITH CHECK is omitted; absence of explicit syntax alone is not a vulnerability finding. The question is whether the **effective** new-row rule prevents a permitted user from changing tenant/source/actor/control state. Prefer explicit comprehensible policies while protecting control columns through grants/commands. Broad CRUD RLS is insufficient when it permits client-set actor or safety fields.

Views must preserve underlying actor authorization (for example qualified invoker semantics when suitable), and RPC/function security, execute grants, fixed safe search paths and service-role use must be reviewed together. A privileged service path must supply the same tenant/source/capability checks; calling with a service key is not evidence of user permission. No raw CMS-admin queries or browser access to secret source receipts is introduced. Public media remains subject to its source delivery policy even when the enclosing preview is passive.

### REQ26-D27-DATA_CONTRACT-S0006 — Search and preview

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

The query is explicit staff input. The shared owner evaluates title, summary and eligible public text over the exact Active selected corpus, ranked in that order with stable identity tie-break. D27 requires this behavior; partial title-only implementations are not silently treated as complete. Use P23's qualified Postgres search projection and batch current-head approach; extra infrastructure requires measured evidence.

Selection filtering and current tenant/Site/locale/public-generation/safety checks precede pagination, counts and snippets. An ordinary public search endpoint that deliberately excludes Shared-by-link Pages cannot be the exhaustive Guidance source: extend the **same owner** with a private staff-catalog query contract over explicitly selected sources, preserving each source's public access proof. This is a private operational selection projection, not a new public search inclusion rule or new authority for article content.

Only return safe source text and public metadata. The preview does not hydrate forms/giving components, execute CMS HTML or expose draft/editor fields. Owner-rendered safe public text/media is preferred; link insertion uses D23's existing Tiptap semantics. No Lexical-to-Tiptap article conversion. Cache keys/projection records are qualified by environment/tenant/source/Site/locale, selection/current public generations and applicable authorization scope; no forbidden hit/count/snippet can survive a favorable stale cache.

### REQ26-D27-DATA_CONTRACT-S0007 — Lifecycle and concurrency matrix

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Event                                                              | Selection/finder                                                           | Draft/new preparation                                                               | Sealed but definitely unsubmitted / possible submission                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Add exact public Page                                              | Active after one command; qualified offer once projection current          | New deliberate insertion permitted                                                  | No unrelated message effect                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Remove from guidance                                               | Removed; no new finder offers                                              | Existing safe occurrence/reusable wording can remain; no source withdrawal inferred | Prepared safe bytes unchanged                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Ordinary text/title edit                                           | Active preview updates from current public source                          | Existing label/href remain frozen; new links use current title/destination          | Prepared bytes unchanged                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Source unavailable transiently                                     | Checking/unavailable, not false Unpublished                                | Hold affected new qualification/preparation; unaffected work continues              | Existing valid local sealed material/fences decide; no dispatch CMS I/O or global outage gate                                                                                                                            |
| Unpublish/no public eligibility without same-source continuity     | Active but unavailable; current adverse state dominates stale result/index | Stop new use/preparation and require review of affected occurrence                  | Revoke exact definitely-unsubmitted dependents via source disposition/safety epoch; preserve/reconcile already possible submission                                                                                       |
| Dangerous withdrawal                                               | Unavailable; prevent new use and stale snippets                            | Preserve applicable D18 known-material restriction, not just URL status             | Existing Revoke unsubmitted/submission race semantics; never recall or rekey possible success                                                                                                                            |
| Same-Page/Site/exact-locale route change with qualified continuity | Future links use current canonical URL                                     | Existing unchanged href can qualify through owner continuity; no rewrite            | Frozen bytes may remain under current qualified fences                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Different-Page redirect or domain reclaim                          | No inherited selection                                                     | Deliberate replacement-source reselection required for new Guidance use/preparation | A lost approved-source dependency follows owner no-new-use fences; existing bytes never rewritten to new Page                                                                                                            |
| Restore to draft                                                   | Still unavailable                                                          | No new use                                                                          | No automatic safety release                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Qualified republication/safety release                             | Active selection may recover; Removed stays Removed                        | New proof allows new use; historical text not rewritten                             | A copied link from a Removed selection may requalify without restoring its finder entry. Fenced/terminal prepared artifacts never auto-revive; current P17 recovery/successor preparation and authorized admission apply |
| Late favorable event                                               | Cannot override current selection/source/safety generation                 | No revival                                                                          | No rollback of admission/submission facts                                                                                                                                                                                |

Curation and publication are independent state machines. Ordinary editorial updates do not require a second approval queue. Source withdrawal is not finder removal. A CMS restore is not a public release. A sent link is historical message content, not an eternal promise the public Page remains available. Immutable identity/content meaning is not indefinite byte retention: P17 purges sealed provider-request material on qualified acceptance under its existing finality/custody rule; later reconciliation uses its body-free evidence. Each actual message copy follows its own owner retention.

### REQ26-D27-DATA_CONTRACT-S0008 — Email Studio, Tiptap and P6 sequence

Applies to **US26-D27-07**, acceptance **AC26-D27-07-01–03**.

1. Staff chooses a qualified public source in Guidance. Support verifies current draft/purpose/access and source selection/public proof, then performs one editor transaction. Visible content is a normal link. Trusted provenance uses the existing typed source-occurrence grammar; arbitrary pasted HTML attributes cannot forge qualification.
2. Draft editing, Undo, recovery and saved wording follow D18/D23 source rules. Editing text preserves source provenance; changing href removes the approved-source assertion for that destination while known source-derived material restrictions remain. No policy pretends to recognize arbitrary manually retyped URLs. The normal link dialog must make the changed destination visible.
3. When preparing an email, P17 qualifies source occurrences/current public-purpose destination and existing signature/sender/audience/rendering. It freezes the exact resulting label/href and body into the same immutable preparation as the rest of the reply. It owns the minimal source-material manifest and current safety epoch/fence relationship. Support does not store a second article or generate a separate signature/preparation.
4. Support admits the actual reply under current conversation/inbox/audience/work authorization. P6 dispatch checks the existing qualified local source/material safety fences at its current atomic submission boundary. Adverse fence wins before submission → do not submit; possible submission wins first → reconcile exact attempt, never guess failure and resend. No CMS, URL fetch, editor render or source substitution occurs here.
5. Internal notes use their existing internal document/policy path and never enter P6 merely because they contain a public Guidance link. Guidance does not change a recipient, add CC, trigger a shortcut/work effect, choose a signature or complete a business action.

The source-family extension must specify issuer/consumer ownership, adverse-first local fence publication, version compatibility and recovery under existing P17/P23 machinery before activation. A UI disabled state or eventually removed search index alone cannot enforce withdrawal. An outage after sealing does not require fetching the CMS again; the existing local material contract is the dispatch authority.

### REQ26-D27-DATA_CONTRACT-S0009 — CRM, retention and operational evidence

Applies to **US26-D27-06**, acceptance **AC26-D27-06-01–03**.

CRM references are those already qualified in D9/D26. Guidance does not create another interaction stream or feed article previews to CRM search. Opening Support from CRM still requires current joint access; financial/member-care/missionary restrictions do not vanish with a shared conversation.

Public source revisions live under the CMS owner. Search projections/caches are derived under that owner's retention and invalidation. Curation history keeps minimal tenant/source/actor/transition facts under existing audit custody. Draft/prepared/sent occurrences and their source lineage follow D17/P17 retention; no message body or copied Page goes into an indefinite Guidance audit table. Exports show only authorized owner data and cannot rehydrate expired content from an old preview or provenance payload. Backups/deletion follow each owner contract, not a new Support-specific backup promise.

Named signals and responses are O01–O06; P01–P36 cover positive/negative, authorization, concurrency, privacy, migration, release and actual user outcomes. No DB/RLS migration, provider call, operational repair or implementation was performed. The documentary/source checks prove record consistency and current source observations only.

### REQ26-D27-R02 — D27-R02 Source identity and authority

Applies to **US26-D27-01**, acceptance **AC26-D27-01-01–03**.

Each selection SHALL reference the exact operational tenant, CMS owner namespace, Site, stable Page and locale lineage using their existing owner-defined identifier types. Environment isolation SHALL be preserved. Slugs, titles, login hosts, email domains, matching email addresses and stringified CMS tenant IDs SHALL NOT establish these identities. Operational-to-CMS references SHALL be validated soft references; no cross-schema FK or operational article-body copy is permitted.

### REQ26-D27-R03 — D27-R03 Current public eligibility

Applies to **US26-D27-01**, acceptance **AC26-D27-01-01–03**.

Selection, editorial read permission, a draft preview URL and a Payload published flag SHALL NOT individually certify public eligibility. The source owner SHALL supply current proof for the exact Page/Site/locale, public generation, public-purpose route, primary-domain authority and applicable safety state. Unknown proof SHALL be unavailable for new selection/insertion/preparation, with a truthful retry state. Public reads SHALL use the qualified public bridge even for privileged staff and SHALL NOT fall back to an editorial reader.

### REQ26-D27-R04 — D27-R04 Public reach and language

Applies to **US26-D27-01**, acceptance **AC26-D27-01-01–03**.

Both Listed publicly and owner-qualified Shared by link — public Page variants MAY be deliberately selected. Selection SHALL NOT add the latter to public search, navigation or sitemap, or represent them as private. Each Site/locale variant SHALL be selected explicitly. No implicit translation, language fallback, unrelated-site substitution or new translation admission is allowed. Existing owner-qualified same-source language alternatives remain deliberate, visibly language-labelled choices.

### REQ26-D27-R05 — D27-R05 One curated set and permissions

Applies to **US26-D27-03**, acceptance **AC26-D27-03-01–03**.

Use one flat tenant selection set. Existing P12/current Support shared-content management capabilities with tenant oversight SHALL govern adding/removing selections; no new role enum, inbox copies, approval chain or folder hierarchy is introduced. Ordinary authorized Support staff MAY consult the active public set; source-reference discovery and CMS editing/publication retain independent owner permissions. Curation SHALL NOT grant CMS write access or access to another tenant's administrative catalog.

### REQ26-D27-R06 — D27-R06 Selection lifecycle

Applies to **US26-D27-03**, acceptance **AC26-D27-03-01–03**.

Selection is Active or Removed, with immutable transition history and a current generation. Available, Unavailable and Checking are derived public-eligibility presentations, not client-writable publication states. Remove from guidance SHALL affect future finder offers, not unpublish the Page or revoke otherwise safe links already composed. Republication MAY restore an Active selection only after current qualification; it SHALL NOT restore a Removed selection. Restoring a CMS draft is not republication. Deliberate re-add uses the same stable selection identity and a new generation.

### REQ26-D27-R07 — D27-R07 Search contract

Applies to **US26-D27-01**, acceptance **AC26-D27-01-01–03**.

The finder SHALL search current selected eligible Page titles, summaries and the owner's eligible public textual content, in that relevance order with a stable tie-break. It SHALL reuse the qualified P23 search/read projection and current-proof checks, extending the shared owner interface only where necessary. It SHALL NOT use the latest Updates list, crawl URLs, filter an already capped public search page, or create a second authoritative text corpus. Body search is part of this chosen contract: an implementation lacking it SHALL NOT advertise complete Guidance search or activate the complete feature. Source content/keywords remain source-owned; no parallel Support alias taxonomy is added. The shared owner query SHALL cover the complete selected staff-purpose population, including eligible textual content of explicitly selected Shared-by-link variants, without admitting those variants to public discovery.

### REQ26-D27-R08 — D27-R08 Simple visible scope

Applies to **US26-D27-01**, acceptance **AC26-D27-01-01–03**.

The finder SHALL open manually with an empty query and a bounded browsable list. Provide Search guidance plus Language and Site filters only where meaningful choices exist. Initial scope MAY use an explicitly resolved conversation language/site; otherwise display All languages/All sites. Do not infer language or representation from names, addresses or CRM relationships. Visible chips, independent clearing, clear sorting and distinct empty/error states SHALL prevent hidden narrowing or silent broadening. Do not persist raw queries in shared views, URLs, analytics or durable search history.

### REQ26-D27-R09 — D27-R09 Passive preview

Applies to **US26-D27-01**, acceptance **AC26-D27-01-01–03**.

Preview SHALL use the source owner's safe public projection, show title, Site, language and public destination, and provide Open public page. It SHALL NOT mount a full interactive site, execute scripts/forms/donation widgets, fetch arbitrary embeds or load editor-only data inside staff context. Unsupported meaningful sections SHALL be identified with an explicit public-page action rather than silently omitted. Approved static media SHALL use owner delivery/privacy rules and lazy loading. Preview content is derived, never an editable Support article.

### REQ26-D27-R10 — D27-R10 Deliberate insertion

Applies to **US26-D27-02**, acceptance **AC26-D27-02-01–03**.

Insert link SHALL add the current human-readable source title at a valid caret. For an ordinary link-eligible text selection, the action SHALL read Link selected text and preserve the selected wording. It SHALL NOT silently replace selected text with the article title. A stale or unsupported selection SHALL return staff to a valid draft position without losing their text. One command inserts one source-qualified link; opening or previewing never inserts or sends.

### REQ26-D27-R11 — D27-R11 Draft and surface continuity

Applies to **US26-D27-02**, acceptance **AC26-D27-02-01–03**.

Guidance SHALL preserve the exact conversation, current private draft, Reply/Internal note purpose, recipients, cursor, signature and work state through preview, navigation, cancellation and retry. It uses D23's existing Tiptap profiles and D26's same inline/full-page Support detail through CRM. A read-only user MAY consult but cannot create or mutate a draft. No duplicate CRM composer, hidden second draft or insertion into a newly focused conversation is permitted. The intake brief is not extended with a new Guidance authoring workflow by this decision.

### REQ26-D27-R12 — D27-R12 Link representation and provenance

Applies to **US26-D27-02**, acceptance **AC26-D27-02-01–03**.

A Guidance occurrence SHALL contain frozen visible text/href plus minimal trusted source/selection/locale/destination qualification provenance in the existing typed document/dependency contract. No article body, requester data or private CMS record is embedded. External HTML/plain text SHALL contain ordinary accessible links without internal provenance or authorization tokens. Editing link text preserves applicable provenance. Changing its destination SHALL remove the assertion that the new URL is selected Guidance while retaining existing D18 restrictions on known source-derived material; client metadata is never proof.

### REQ26-D27-R13 — D27-R13 Editing, reuse and undo

Applies to **US26-D27-02**, acceptance **AC26-D27-02-01–03**.

Insert, Link selected text, Undo/Redo, copy, saved wording, draft recovery and normal document edits SHALL preserve applicable D18/D23 provenance and purpose rules. Saving a Guidance link in reusable wording SHALL use the existing wording owner and requalification at use, with no article clone. A removed finder selection does not retroactively prohibit safe saved wording. A source withdrawal cannot be bypassed by native Undo, source-metadata stripping or changing only link text. Arbitrarily manually retyped URLs remain ordinary links; this does not claim global detection or policing.

### REQ26-D27-R14 — D27-R14 Ordinary edits and route continuity

Applies to **US26-D27-02**, acceptance **AC26-D27-02-01–03**.

Routine Page title/body edits SHALL update future finder previews but SHALL NOT rewrite composed or sent wording/hrefs or require per-revision Support approval. Newly inserted links use the current source-owned canonical destination. An unchanged older href MAY remain usable only through owner-qualified same-Page, same-Site, exact-locale public-route continuity. A valid redirect to a different Page does not transfer the Guidance selection to that Page. New Guidance use/preparation then requires deliberate source reselection; no HTTP-200, title match or redirect-following heuristic substitutes for owner proof.

### REQ26-D27-R15 — D27-R15 Withdrawal and restoration

Applies to **US26-D27-02**, acceptance **AC26-D27-02-01–03**.

Unpublish, loss of public eligibility, unsafe destination or domain release without qualified same-source continuity SHALL stop new qualification and fence exact definitely-unsubmitted dependent sends through the owner's no-new-public-use disposition and existing P17 Revoke unsubmitted/safety epochs. Dangerous privacy/security withdrawal SHALL additionally preserve applicable known material restrictions. Already accepted or possibly submitted messages SHALL preserve immutable effect identity/content meaning and reconciliation under each owner's actual retention, including P17 purge of sealed provider-request material on qualified acceptance and body-free later evidence; no recall or indefinite byte custody is promised. Finder restoration requires current owner safety release/public proof and an Active selection. Existing copied/D18 links from a Removed selection MAY requalify from current same-source public/safety proof without restoring the finder selection. No restoration automatically revives a fenced or terminal prepared effect: current P17 recovery/successor preparation and authorized admission rules apply, never a stale favorable event.

### REQ26-D27-R16 — D27-R16 Email Studio and P6 seam

Applies to **US26-D27-07**, acceptance **AC26-D27-07-01–03**.

P17/Email Studio SHALL own source-aware wording/preparation, purpose profiles, signature placement, render validation, immutable prepared bytes and material/dependency fences; Support SHALL own draft/work authorization and send admission; P6 SHALL own transport/submission evidence/reconciliation. Add only the narrow Guidance-reference dependency family required by R12–R15. Source qualification occurs before preparation; admission/dispatch use current qualified local fences and existing atomic submission boundaries, with no CMS/URL/network fetch or rerender after sealing. Internal notes remain internal and are not outgoing email preparations. Independently authorized post-derived notifications retain their own qualified P17/P6 boundary.

### REQ26-D27-R17 — D27-R17 CRM and business boundaries

Applies to **US26-D27-07**, acceptance **AC26-D27-07-01–03**.

Opening Guidance, previewing a Page or inserting a link SHALL NOT create/link/merge a CRM Party, add a CRM Activity or last-contact event, change a financial record, satisfy identity verification or resolve a Support request. D9/D26 qualified CRM links and current joint authorization govern viewing the conversation. Requester, participant, authenticated user, Party, represented organization, handler and CRM owner remain distinct. Giving/contact/missionary actions remain deliberate owning-domain commands; guidance may explain them but cannot perform or certify them.

### REQ26-D27-R18 — D27-R18 Atomic curation and idempotency

Applies to **US26-D27-03**, acceptance **AC26-D27-03-01–03**.

One authorized owner command SHALL atomically admit the selection transition, trusted actor/time, expected generation, durable receipt, audit and required secondary-effect continuation. Concurrent adds cannot create duplicate active references; stale edits/removals/re-adds cannot overwrite newer intent. Retry keys bind the durable curation effect and payload digest, not one HTTP attempt. Source facts are qualified through their owner; no distributed transaction or dual write to Payload is introduced. After ambiguous success, resolve the command receipt before retrying.

### REQ26-D27-R19 — D27-R19 Database and authorization enforcement

Applies to **US26-D27-06**, acceptance **AC26-D27-06-01–03**.

Non-null tenant/source identity, typed relationships, uniqueness, valid states and protected control fields SHALL be enforced through constraints and the single authoritative mutation boundary. Tenant-aware operational FKs, indexes and restricted delete behavior SHALL protect local relationships; owner-defined soft references protect the CMS seam. Grants, RLS, column privileges, views, RPCs, service paths and storage delivery SHALL enforce the same capability boundary. Both existing-row USING and resulting-row WITH CHECK semantics SHALL be verified; a permitted update cannot move a row into another tenant/source/approval state. Actor, tenant, approval, owner and audit fields derive from trusted context. No service key reaches clients.

### REQ26-D27-R20 — D27-R20 Derived data and privacy

Applies to **US26-D27-06**, acceptance **AC26-D27-06-01–03**.

Search documents, caches, excerpts and preview state SHALL be explicitly derived and disposable under source generation/safety and selection generations. Current qualified eligibility SHALL filter hits, counts and snippets before exposure; a shared cache key cannot omit tenant/environment/site/locale/selection/authorization scope. No private message, attachment name or CRM fact is sent automatically as a source query, copied to CMS, embedded in an outbound guidance URL or retained in technical logs. D17 and owner retention govern message-derived provenance; it cannot become an indefinite second transcript store.

### REQ26-D27-R21 — D27-R21 Failures and partial availability

Applies to **US26-D27-01**, acceptance **AC26-D27-01-01–03**.

Show No guidance selected, No matches and Guidance temporarily unavailable as distinct states. An unknown source SHALL NOT be labelled unpublished. Failed/unknown qualification SHALL hold only affected references/preparations, not all Support composition or unaffected replies. Favorable indexing lag may omit a newly eligible item. When coverage is incomplete or updating, staff results SHALL disclose that state; No matches is shown only for a complete qualified query. Curators additionally receive per-source repair/status detail. Adverse states cannot rely on eventual purge alone. Recovery/replay SHALL use existing P23/P17 durable work and current owner heads, with no direct database repair as the normal procedure.

### REQ26-D27-R22 — D27-R22 Maintenance journey

Applies to **US26-D27-03**, acceptance **AC26-D27-03-01–03**.

Manage guidance SHALL expose source identity, current public eligibility, Site/language and the last curator transition, with Add to guidance and Remove from guidance. Edit in Web Studio and publication controls belong to Web Studio and require its permissions. No inline duplicate article editor is provided. Source content can improve without routine Support reapproval; curators remain accountable for suitability and obsolete selections. If no suitable Page exists, preserve the Support draft and use the existing authorized CMS work path; never auto-create a ticket, publish a conversation or copy its private content into a content request.

### REQ26-D27-R23 — D27-R23 Accessible, coherent presentation

Applies to **US26-D27-01**, acceptance **AC26-D27-01-01–03**.

Use Core's shared base-maia/Base UI components, semantic tokens and existing detail/context patterns. Guidance SHALL be keyboard and screen-reader operable with visible focus, correct dialog/list semantics, named actions, meaningful link text, non-color state labels and announced results without focus theft. Narrow screens use one layered finder/preview with Back returning to query, scroll and draft; Escape closes only the current layer. Reflow, zoom, RTL, IME, reduced motion and low-bandwidth behavior SHALL be qualified. No drag-only action, hover-only preview or new workspace navigation is required.

### REQ26-D27-R24 — D27-R24 Performance and completeness

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

Use indexed tenant/selection/source queries, owner search ranking, batched current-head checks and bounded keyset pagination. Evaluate the selected eligible corpus before pagination/counts; no client-side cap filtering or N+1 owner requests. The release capacity profile SHALL name tenants, Pages per tenant, locales, selected corpus size, text sizes, concurrent searches, update/withdrawal rate, payload bounds and latency budgets; prove at each declared limit and one beyond with explicit bounded rejection/degradation. No fixed universal page count or new search provider is justified without measurements. Core/P23's existing capacity and convergence contracts remain the starting point.

### REQ26-D27-R25 — D27-R25 History and diagnostics

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

Curation history SHALL record stable source references, actor, trusted time, transition/generation, reason for consequential changes, receipt and outcome without article/message bodies. Technical traces SHALL separately record safe correlation IDs, source-proof disposition, cache/index generation, denial class and P17/P6 effect state. Staff see actionable reason/retry/source-owner navigation; tenant oversight sees unavailable selections. No raw query, secret link token, message content or private preview is required to diagnose failure.

### REQ26-D27-R26 — D27-R26 Additive rollout and compatibility

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

Qualify the public owner extension, stable source mapping/search, selection command and Guidance document dependency before enabling the UI. Migrate operational and Payload schemas only through their own owners. Old readers/writers SHALL neither drop provenance nor interpret unknown dependency families as safe; fence unsupported versions. Backfills use source evidence and a deterministic report, never URL/title identity guessing or auto-selection of all published Pages. A finder kill switch disables new use while existing prepared messages keep their P17/P6 safety contracts. Roll forward after new documents exist unless old code is proven compatible; do not delete new fields to simulate rollback.

### REQ26-D27-R27 — D27-R27 Explicit dependency limits

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

The current shared reader is a seam, not complete proof of P23/P24 stable Site/locale/domain/search behavior. Activation SHALL depend on the named qualified contracts, not on an open PR number or a marketing feature. Use one Payload public implementation and the shared API interface, not a Support-only Local API shortcut, cross-product synchronization or URL scraper. Tiptap remains the Support editor; the CMS's editor/schema is not replaced or converted by D27. No provider upgrade, package installation or paid AI feature is selected here.

### REQ26-D27-R28 — D27-R28 Proof and traceability

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

Every clause maps to its owning implementation/design requirement and independently verifiable user/domain outcome. All adopted Public proof cases remain required; source probes and documentary checks do not substitute for runtime, DB/RLS, accessibility or staff usability evidence. Existing terminology, work, delivery, retention and CRM invariants remain subject only to the explicitly qualified source-reference extension and later accepted refinements.

### REQ26-D27-R29 — D27-R29 Monitoring is bounded

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

Only the residual signals O01–O06 below may be monitored after the associated prevention/proof exists. Each has a named owning team/capability, threshold and response. A missing owner, unregistered capacity budget, unauthorized result or missing safety fence is a release blocker, not something to monitor into correctness. Monitoring SHALL not require recording private queries or customer text.

### REQ26-D27-R30 — D27-R30 Product validation and exclusions

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

Before release, representative tenant staff SHALL complete the ordinary finder, correct-language choice, linked-text insertion, CRM return, source removal and unavailable-source recovery journeys without facilitator intervention or unauthorized side effects. Record task outcomes and confusion, not a claim of perfection from a mockup. The exact public-content inventory and observed demand across tenants remain empirical release inputs; they do not prevent recording this bounded direction. Staff may still write a helpful answer or use existing saved replies when guidance is absent.

**All P01–P36 groups are required and unexecuted.** They are falsifiable acceptance groups for the later implementation/release, not tests run against a proposed schema. The existing-source probe's seven observations are reported separately.

### REQ26-D27-PRIMARY-S0036 — Residual operating controls

Applies to **US26-D27-08**, acceptance **AC26-D27-08-01–03**.

These are product responsibility names, not invented staff assignments. Actual team/on-call ownership must be registered before activation. Existing P23/P17 operational contracts may supply the mechanisms; D27 does not create another monitoring platform.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Control | Signal and threshold                                                                                                                                                | Owner and response                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| O01     | Any confirmed wrong-tenant/source result, unauthorized snippet/count or forbidden curation effect: **1 occurrence**.                                                | Core identity/access owner with Support owner: disable affected finder path, contain exposure, inspect exact receipt/cache/proof and require negative-test correction before re-enable.                                                     |
| O02     | Any Guidance-dependent send crossing a current no-new-public-use fence while definitely unsubmitted: **1 occurrence**.                                              | P17/P6 messaging owner with public-content owner: stop affected dependency dispatch, preserve possible-submission evidence, reconcile and repair fence/order proof; never blind retry.                                                      |
| O03     | Failed/unknown current source eligibility for an Active selection: **1 confirmed selection**.                                                                       | Tenant Guidance curator: display unavailable status immediately; source owner resolves publication/domain/proof; ordinary source state is not automatically removed. Existing owner convergence deadline breach escalates to its on-call.   |
| O04     | Any curation receipt without required continuation after the existing registered durable-work recovery deadline: **1 receipt**.                                     | Support platform owner: reconcile/replay from receipt and current generations; no duplicate transition or manual body copy.                                                                                                                 |
| O05     | Search p95 exceeds the release's registered latency budget for **two consecutive 5-minute windows**, or one confirmed qualifying hit omitted by cap/post-filtering. | Shared public-search owner: profile batch/index/query, reduce bounded load or disable affected lookup; correct completeness defects before re-enable. An unset budget blocks release.                                                       |
| O06     | One confirmed staff report that a selected Page is misleading, obsolete or wrong-purpose, or one observed accidental action in a required journey.                  | Tenant Guidance curator for content; Support UX owner for interaction: remove unsuitable selection or correct source/flow, re-run affected journey and document outcome. No private-query collection or mandatory surveillance is required. |

## Sampled automatic feedback

### REQ26-D28-R01 — D28-R01 Purpose and strongest alternatives

Applies to **US26-D28-01**, acceptance **AC26-D28-01-01–03**.

Provide an optional modest automatic sample of Support feedback invitations. Off is a complete supported state. Manual per-case invitation selection and a parallel runtime policy are not added. Do not claim that survey demand, response rates, donor preferences or representativeness have been measured in Asym tenants.

### REQ26-D28-R02 — D28-R02 Small policy surface

Applies to **US26-D28-01**, acceptance **AC26-D28-01-01–03**.

Provide one tenant-owned Automatic invitations policy, default Off, with selected qualified inboxes and a validated integer percentage 1–100 (enabled preset 25). Display fixed 24-hour quiet delay, 30-day mailbox gap and no reminders as plain-language guarantees. Zero is Off, not a hidden second mode; reject fractions, NaN, negative and over-100 values on the server. Percentage-only edits affect newly created completion candidates; existing candidates retain their frozen percentage. Off and inbox removal are immediately adverse current gates. No conditions builder, campaigns, per-agent opt-in, sentiment exceptions, donation-tier targeting or exact invitation quota.

### REQ26-D28-R03 — D28-R03 Enablement and authority

Applies to **US26-D28-01**, acceptance **AC26-D28-01-01–03**.

Only a separately qualified tenant feedback-policy manager may enable or change the policy; D19 intake reviewer or D27 guide publisher status alone grants nothing. Require a named accountable tenant Support feedback owner and a qualified review route with coverage. Current scoped Support readers may see feedback for conversations they can read; feedback review and privacy redaction are separately qualified mutations. Inbox scope, transport readiness, P3 contactability, P17 purpose/action readiness, finite data custody and release proof must all pass before On. Disabled prerequisites have a clear owner action; a saved draft is not Active.

### REQ26-D28-R04 — D28-R04 Eligibility is source-owned

Applies to **US26-D28-02**, acceptance **AC26-D28-02-01–03**.

A genuine ordinary Resolved completion can create a generation-bound candidate while the policy and inbox are enabled. At maturity, current source facts must still show completed ordinary work, an admitted external human request, qualified actual human email correspondence with that recipient, and a currently qualified recipient/send basis. A known accepted human reply establishes only transport evidence, not human receipt or satisfaction. Unresolved submission, missing authority, No response endings, spam/auto-only intake, drafts, internal-note-only work, restricted care content, suppressed endpoints and manual-only work lacking actual qualified email do not establish eligibility. A caller-supplied closure intent is not completion evidence: still-owed Support commitments and actionable unreviewed recovery block it under the existing owner rules. No arbitrary minimum message count or AI judgment substitutes for these facts. Exclusions and the email-only population limit are reported honestly.

### REQ26-D28-R05 — D28-R05 Candidate, opportunity and quiet interval

Applies to **US26-D28-02**, acceptance **AC26-D28-02-01–03**.

Completion creates a candidate with original conversation identity, exact resolution generation, frozen policy revision/percentage and due_at = genuine completion admission time + 24 elapsed hours. Reopening or relevant new admitted input before maturity invalidates that generation; later genuinely completed work can start a new candidate if no opportunity has been sampled. At mature admission, atomically create the one durable opportunity per original conversation and its sampling decision. After a draw, reopening or relevant new input cancels every definitely-unsubmitted invitation from that generation; the original opportunity stays consumed and later completion cannot resurrect the selected result. Old callbacks cannot sample a newer generation. Do not backdate a draw or apply a worker's processing-time percentage to an older candidate.

### REQ26-D28-R06 — D28-R06 Random selection without repeated chances

Applies to **US26-D28-02**, acceptance **AC26-D28-02-01–03**.

Generate one unbiased server-side cryptographically secure integer draw in [0, 9999] at opportunity admission, persist it with frozen percent and algorithm version, and select iff draw < percent × 100. A linked-suppression disposition instead has no local draw and a required same-tenant source-opportunity reference; the exclusive branch cannot be changed later. The unique original opportunity key makes concurrent creation/retries return the same decision. Neither client randomness, worker RNG retries, mutable tags, every-Nth closures, permanently selected mailbox cohorts nor a new percentage may replace it. Selected is not sent: later current safety/contact limits may reduce actual invitations. Do not compensate by drawing replacements or silently increasing the percentage.

### REQ26-D28-R07 — D28-R07 One justified recipient

Applies to **US26-D28-03**, acceptance **AC26-D28-03-01–03**.

Bind one exact external endpoint through current source-owned recipient authority from the actual request/correspondence. Do not use the first CRM match, first linked Party, assigned worker, represented organization, current CRM email or every To/Cc participant. Unknown/unlinked people remain eligible only through the explicitly qualified no-Party endpoint branch; no fake Party is created. Multiple plausible recipients, shared/on-behalf ambiguity or changed authority are skipped with a safe reason. Do not prompt staff to select a likely positive recipient at closure. A mailbox can be shared; the response therefore represents whoever possessed that invitation, not verified speech by a particular human.

### REQ26-D28-R08 — D28-R08 Independent frequency protection

Applies to **US26-D28-03**, acceptance **AC26-D28-03-01–03**.

At the final submission admission, atomically reserve the tenant + owner-normalized opaque recipient endpoint across all included inboxes and all current D10-linked originals. Require at least 2,592,000 elapsed seconds since prior submission-may-have-begun. A still-permitted or in-flight crossing holds the endpoint guard. Once P6 proves no old future/in-flight crossing is possible, a different genuine opportunity may pass after 30 days from the latest possible crossing bound even if the historical provider outcome remains indeterminate. Historical uncertainty alone is not a permanent mailbox suppression; no timeout releases the guard early. Qualify that finite crossing bound in P6 before activation. Concurrent readers of an old cooldown cannot both submit. A definitely-unsubmitted cancelled reservation may be released under its exact generation; possible submission consumes the opportunity and gap. Do not strip plus-addressing, guess alias equivalence or join mailboxes by a CRM merge. This protects a mailbox, not a provable unique donor across all aliases or tenants.

### REQ26-D28-R09 — D28-R09 Current gates and full invitation Off

Applies to **US26-D28-01**, acceptance **AC26-D28-01-01–03**.

Off fences every new or definitely-unsubmitted optional invitation without waiting for cancellation fan-out. Clear queued presentation through idempotent cleanup, but the current policy/source epoch is authoritative at the P6 boundary. Scope removal applies the same rule for that inbox. Existing submitted/possibly-submitted evidence remains truthful; issued response authority retains its original expiry unless its own privacy/safety source is revoked. The Off UI explains both facts. Off→On never resurrects cancelled generations or samples old completed history. Ordinary Support replies, intake and owner work remain available independently. A human reply to the invitation uses D1/D25’s qualified source/thread correlation and current intake; it is actual correspondence, not a rating submission. If original content is unavailable, existing source-safe intake applies without resurrection or email-only CRM matching.

### REQ26-D28-R10 — D28-R10 Finite usefulness and exact time

Applies to **US26-D28-03**, acceptance **AC26-D28-03-01–03**.

An invitation's send-by is its candidate due_at + 24 elapsed hours. Do not start a definitely-unsubmitted effect at or after send-by. Any permitted recovery of the same effect follows existing P6 rules inside that window; no new idempotency identity or new send after utility expires. Mint the feedback action only for qualifying preparation after due; expires_at is no later than issued_at + 14 elapsed days and any earlier source/privacy ceiling. Show the actual expiry date after authorized handoff; do not promise 14 days after delivery. Provider callbacks, rerender, policy edits, clock-zone changes and retries cannot renew these limits. All comparisons use trusted UTC instants; UI formats the relevant locale/time zone and elapsed-day wording avoids DST ambiguity.

### REQ26-D28-R11 — D28-R11 Merge, Undo and historical conservation

Applies to **US26-D28-02**, acceptance **AC26-D28-02-01–03**.

Keep immutable original conversation/opportunity/effect identities. Before sampling and submission, serialize against current D10 topology. If multiple unsampled candidates belong to one current component, select one neutrally eligible representative by earliest genuine completion instant then stable original ID and admit only its draw. Any prior component opportunity, including Not selected, prevents another original supplying a new chance. Record an immutable linked-suppression disposition for each otherwise eligible losing original, referencing that original opportunity without a fresh draw; Undo cannot revive it. Two independently committed pre-merge draws remain historical facts. A component with a prior possible/submitted invitation suppresses pending duplicates. If independent pending invitations merge, retain one deterministically by earliest genuine completion instant then original stable ID and suppress others. Two invitations submitted before their conversations merged remain two historical facts; no history rewrite or recall fiction. Undo alone creates no invitation, restores no cancelled generation and grants no new draw. CRM Party merging is distinct from Support merging and cannot create or transfer sampling authority.

### REQ26-D28-R12 — D28-R12 Separate email effect and Email Studio purpose

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

Feedback is a separately registered optional Support invitation purpose and effect, never a rating link automatically appended to every reply/signature or an implicit D4/D5 send. P17 governs its structured wording, locale, team identity, layout/signature, fixed protected CTA and immutable preparation. Suppressing feedback must never reject an ordinary human Support reply. Qualify the no-Party action branch explicitly against P17's current Party/contact wording; existing public guidance URLs do not qualify a feedback action. P6 continues to own transport and ambiguous outcome recovery. No second queue, survey sender, raw HTML template engine or Phase 34 generic workflow prerequisite.

### REQ26-D28-R13 — D28-R13 Preferences and minimization

Applies to **US26-D28-04**, acceptance **AC26-D28-04-01–03**.

Honor P3's absolute do_not_contact, applicable email contactability and actual provider suppression; qualify a narrow feedback-invitation purpose opt-out for Party and no-Party endpoints in that shared owner. Offer “Stop feedback invitations” through a distinct protected preference command, not a marketing unsubscribe or a Support-only consent flag. Its accepted fixed validity is 90 elapsed days from its own issuance, shortened only by its own current P3 contact/privacy authority. Rating Used/14-day expiry, Support reopen/content expiry/deletion and ordinary policy Off never consume or revoke this restriction-only authority. A separate selector/verifier/purpose binds the same qualified endpoint; it cannot read data or increase contact. After its own expiry, generic recovery includes the existing qualified ordinary contact/privacy path; there is no secret-bearing URL fallback or new unsolicited replacement email. This 90-day value is a bounded product judgment, not an industry or legal requirement. The 90 days expires only the preference credential, never the resulting recorded opt-out. The P3 preference persists under its independently authorized lifecycle; policy Off→On, CRM merges, key rotation and new invitations cannot clear it or opt anyone back in. It suppresses future feedback across the tenant; ordinary service/contact rules remain their own owners. No subscription or marketing consent is inferred from participation, a reply, donor status or tenant enablement. Do not classify every survey universally as transactional/legal without purpose/jurisdiction qualification. Keep the invitation free of appeals, giving amounts, missionary locations and case details.

### REQ26-D28-R14 — D28-R14 Scanner-resistant requester entry

Applies to **US26-D28-04**, acceptance **AC26-D28-04-01–03**.

Qualify a closed named response/preference descriptor pair in P17’s manifest/adapter, with separate issuer/purpose/recipient/expiry/revocation/Used state and both pins in prepared evidence; the existing plural action catalog does not prove the current singular producer API already supports the pair. Use the existing single P6/P17 selector + independent fragment verifier doorway exactly: generic inert GET/HEAD, deliberate same-origin Continue POST, short-lived non-authorizing landing session, then explicit Submit feedback POST. The first page resolves no protected tenant/action/resource fact from the selector. No score in URLs, GET vote, auto-POST, account creation, raw token logging, tracking pixels or alternate bearer-link protocol. Reprove tenant/environment, recipient-authorization epoch, purpose, source, expiry/revocation and expected state at every relevant action. Submission authority begins only once the corresponding P6 effect may have submitted, never during editor preview.

### REQ26-D28-R15 — D28-R15 Short neutral response

Applies to **US26-D28-04**, acceptance **AC26-D28-04-01–03**.

Use one fixed, versioned and reviewed localized question: “How satisfied are you with the support you received?” Choices are Dissatisfied, Neither satisfied nor dissatisfied, Satisfied, with no default selection and equal visual weight. Add optional plain-text “What would you like us to know?” limited to 2,000 Unicode scalar values, no attachments or rich HTML. Explain that authorized staff may read feedback, it is not anonymous, and the form is not an urgent-help channel; do not promise a reply. Rating is required to submit; comment is never required, including for a negative rating. No branching questionnaire, incentive, NPS/CES conflation or satisfaction preselection.

### REQ26-D28-R16 — D28-R16 One response and honest correction

Applies to **US26-D28-04**, acceptance **AC26-D28-04-01–03**.

Allow editing/review before Submit. Atomically admit one logical response with rating, optional comment, exact question version, source invitation and durable receipt. An identical retry returns that privacy-safe receipt; a changed replay conflicts and cannot replace a Used protected action. Do not redisplay a previous comment or transcript through a reused/forwarded link. Staff cannot change the requester's score. A later correction/deletion request uses the existing qualified Support/privacy owner path, with separately attributed correction or redaction and honest report exclusion where applicable; it does not secretly rewrite what was submitted. A valid bearer response is not provider acceptance evidence or proof of who answered.

### REQ26-D28-R17 — D28-R17 Accessible low-bandwidth experience

Applies to **US26-D28-04**, acceptance **AC26-D28-04-01–03**.

Use Core's shared semantic UI styles, native labels/fieldset/radio controls, visible focus, keyboard completion, explicit inline error plus error summary and persistent success. No emoji/color-only scale or auto-advance. Preserve in-memory form input across recoverable failures; do not persist private comments in localStorage/service-worker caches. Narrow mobile is one column, long translations/RTL wrap, 200% zoom remains operable, and network uncertainty shows checking/same-receipt recovery rather than urging another invite. The shared doorway's no-resource CSP remains exact; a no-JavaScript client receives truthful generic recovery rather than a weaker query-token fallback.

### REQ26-D28-R18 — D28-R18 Staff access and review journey

Applies to **US26-D28-05**, acceptance **AC26-D28-05-01–03**.

Support Reports → Feedback is the primary owner view, with date and permitted inbox filters, a compact invitation funnel, rating distribution and a paginated response list. Conversation detail displays one Feedback section with current invitation state, rating/comment when authorized and link to source history. A named permitted review queue covers every submitted response, not only negative ratings; low ratings/comments can be prioritized within it. An idempotent Mark reviewed records reviewer/time without claiming resolution or automatically sending an apology. Any needed follow-up uses existing D3/D4/D26 workflows and current recipient/owner authorization. No new ticket/task is created solely for a score.

### REQ26-D28-R19 — D28-R19 CRM continuity and domain boundaries

Applies to **US26-D28-05**, acceptance **AC26-D28-05-01–03**.

The D9/D26 canonical Support record remains reachable inline/full-page through CRM Communications → Support and the authorized Overview preview. Feedback appears on that same detail under both current CRM-context and Support permissions; a CRM link or record owner grants no extra access. Requester, participant, authenticated user, Party, represented organization, support worker and CRM owner stay distinct. Link/unlink/Party merge may change authorized navigation, never submission attribution or feedback ownership. No duplicate CRM Activity/comment body, current-contact score, auto-created contact, synced directory, giving update, receipt/refund claim or last-contact mutation follows from survey participation. Resolving Support and a satisfied score do not complete business actions.

### REQ26-D28-R20 — D28-R20 Source of truth and custody

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

Support owns policy/candidate/opportunity/response/review facts; the source owner owns recipient authority and opaque contact keys; P3 owns contactability/preferences; P17 owns prepared presentation/material; P6 owns intent/submission/delivery evidence; CRM/giving owners remain unchanged. Derived funnel/cache/search/CRM panels never become write authorities. Distinct immutable origins survive merge/unlink and source restrictions. Feedback rating/comment have their own Support review purpose starting at server submission. Unreviewed feedback is not already purpose-ended by the older conversation’s Resolved state. Qualified review records that purpose end unless genuine continuing ordinary follow-up still needs the source; existing D17 active-purpose reviews, finite interval and earlier owner ceilings govern it. Review/read/link/correction events do not renew expired authority or restart another transcript clock. Retained body-free receipt counts do not preserve expired ratings/comments or imply their continuing availability. Earlier D16 privacy restrictions and qualified holds/disposal always apply.

### REQ26-D28-R21 — D28-R21 Supabase authorization invariants

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

Every tenant-owned record has non-null trusted tenant identity and tenant-aware relationships; current text IDs are preserved rather than casually migrating to UUID. Composite foreign keys or equivalent enforced owner constraints forbid cross-tenant conversation/inbox/opportunity/effect/response links. Unique original opportunity, one effect per opportunity and one response per invitation are database-enforced. Caller input cannot choose tenant, actor, author, approval, sampled draw, recipient proof or reviewed-by fields. Direct broad CRUD must not transform a private/foreign row, reparent an immutable source, revive a terminal state or edit an accepted response. Test grants, SELECT, USING, WITH CHECK, invoker/definer views/RPCs and privileged jobs as one boundary; do not assert existing broad Support RLS already meets it.

### REQ26-D28-R22 — D28-R22 Atomic commands and idempotency

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

Use the existing canonical command/outbox and P6 recovery boundaries. Candidate creation, opportunity draw, intent/effect linkage and required durable secondary intent each commit with their authoritative receipts. Final gate ordering includes current policy/source/topology and endpoint reservation without reversing existing P6 locks. Response admission, Used transition, review obligation and audit references commit atomically; notifications/projections run idempotently from durable intent. Changed input under a reused permanent command key conflicts. After an authoritative write with a lost response, reconcile that receipt; never infer failure from a network timeout. Expiration/revocation and response races have explicit winner/terminal behavior.

### REQ26-D28-R23 — D28-R23 Private storage, logs and disposal

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

Store addresses only in their existing authoritative or encrypted finite delivery custody, not in durable feedback metadata/URLs. Endpoint cooldown and preference lookup use shared owner opaque versioned keys; no public raw-email hashes or client-supplied normalization. Comments and question/freeform renderings never enter technical logs, analytics, notification payloads or public tokens. P17 exact prepared-material/finality disposal remains tighter than ordinary content retention; Recent sent copy excludes action targets. Inventory each comment, rating, source metadata, public session/digest, contact guard, export, projection, backup and audit class with its finite purpose floor/ceiling and hold behavior before activation. Redaction/expiry invalidate all ordinary representations and restore replays suppression before serving. No anonymous-forever archive is implied by pseudonymization.

### REQ26-D28-R24 — D28-R24 Honest measurement

Applies to **US26-D28-06**, acceptance **AC26-D28-06-01–03**.

Report completion candidates/basic exclusions, matured eligible opportunities, selected/not selected, post-selection suppression reasons, submission-may-have-begun, accepted/unknown/failed/delivered evidence and submitted responses as distinct units. Invitation cohort dates are explicit; response-date browsing is distinct from cohort conversion. Preserve original effect counts after merges and show currently permitted original inbox/cohort provenance. Define issued as distinct invitation effects whose submission may have begun. Response fraction is unique responded-issued invitations divided by that same issued cohort, including indeterminate submissions; it never divides all responses only by provider-confirmed acceptances. Present counts and distribution of the three choices; if showing satisfied-share, define Satisfied / all non-excluded submitted ratings and show its denominator. No response is not positive or negative. Sampling is random among qualified opportunities, not all donors or unique people; frequency/eligibility exclusions and voluntary response mean no representativeness or margin-of-error claim. Do not offer employee leaderboards or cross-vendor benchmark comparison.

### REQ26-D28-R25 — D28-R25 Scope and dependencies

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

No external survey provider, synchronization directory, attachments, branch builder, reminders, auto-thank-you email, auto-reopening, bulk invitation action, chat/SMS surveys, public feedback archive, AI classification/sentiment/search or generic campaign/workflow engine is included. Public/Internal Guidance continues to help staff consult/share permitted material; its access/publication does not trigger invitations or feed private content into them. Future AI can consume only separately qualified owner contracts under new research/ratification, never treat survey text as instructions or gain owner-action authority.

### REQ26-D28-R26 — D28-R26 Maintainability and operations

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

Policy managers can inspect readiness, scoped inboxes, selected/suppressed reasons and upcoming due candidates without editing sampling history. Staff review the actual comments and use existing ordinary follow-up when justified. If the accountable reviewer loses access, route body-free attention to tenant oversight and require an eligible replacement; do not broaden inbox/CRM access. Shared-key/provider/readiness failures pause new submission through the existing repair path. Operators may retry only the same eligible effect or acknowledge terminal failure, never rekey old invitations. Percent changes are accountable experiments, not automatic response-rate optimization.

### REQ26-D28-R27 — D28-R27 Bounds and scalability proof

Applies to **US26-D28-06**, acceptance **AC26-D28-06-01–03**.

Use bounded keyset pages of at most 50 records, tenant/inbox/status/due and original/effect endpoint indexes aligned to actual plans, shared endpoint serialization and tenant-fair bounded workers. Do not aggregate only a client-loaded first page or queue one job per recipient for every policy toggle. Release qualification must document actual supported volume and prove at least 100,000 retained opportunity records in one tenant, 10,000 due candidates in a recovery batch and 20 contending workers, with current authorization and skew. These are accepted test fixtures, not measured customer size or production capacity claims. Require first-page feedback list/funnel p 95 ≤2 seconds under the declared fixture and zero duplicate effects; report environment/query plans and enforce tighter existing budgets where applicable.

### REQ26-D28-R28 — D28-R28 Rollout and compatibility

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

Add schema and narrow capabilities/readers first with policy Off; qualify P3/P17/P6 producer seams, privacy inventory, protected landing and worker cancellation before any tenant activation. Do not backfill invitations, draw outcomes, verified recipients or invented response history. New writers must fail readiness on old schema; old broad writers/routes cannot bypass new invariants. Maintain compatible read-only history across feature disablement. A kill switch blocks new admission while reconciliation/response privacy/disposal continue. Roll forward after new source data exists; do not drop tables or restore an old permissive reader as rollback. Restore suppression and current epochs before workers/links become active.

### REQ26-D28-R29 — D28-R29 Acceptance and release evidence

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

Carry R01–R32 and P01–P40 below into required OpenSpec/design/tasks/tickets/tests/release evidence with stable cross-references and exact changed owner contracts. Documentation does not establish completed runtime proof. Execute real RLS/role/concurrency/merge/provider/public-route/accessibility tests against current code when implemented. Research and synthetic reference experiments establish a design basis, not production correctness, measured usability or legal certification.

### REQ26-D28-R30 — D28-R30 Safe correction and residual uncertainty

Applies to **US26-D28-05**, acceptance **AC26-D28-05-01–03**.

Decline/opt-out does not negatively score the requester or change giving eligibility. Feedback may be unfair, misattributed through a shared mailbox or malicious; staff review it as unverified feedback, cannot secretly improve the score, and use existing auditable privacy/abuse exclusion with reason and denominator impact. Excluded comments/ratings are not erased merely to improve reports. No arbitrary fundraising claim, confidential case detail, promised outcome or named personal responder is auto-inserted into the invitation. Qualify tenant-selected public team identity and an actual monitored reply route.

### REQ26-D28-R31 — D28-R31 Concrete unresolved evidence

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

Tenant volumes, requester response preferences, mobile completion friction through the existing doorway and the efficacy of the 25% preset are not observed facts. The permanent answer is bounded defaults plus the named operational controls and release tests, not a claim of perfection. No unresolved owner-authority choice is deferred to runtime: the no-Party feedback action and purpose opt-out are explicit prerequisite amendments. No-go readiness remains visible until their actual proof passes.

### REQ26-D28-UX_BLUEPRINT-S0002 — Tenant setup, save and maintenance

Applies to **US26-D28-07**, acceptance **AC26-D28-07-01–03**.

The tenant manager reaches **Support settings → Feedback** from the existing Support settings area. There is one compact policy card, not a marketing campaign wizard. Header: **Automatic feedback invitations**. Supporting sentence: “Invite feedback after a random sample of eligible completed Support conversations.” Initial state: **Off**. Adjacent status distinguishes Off, On and Needs attention; a failed readiness check never appears On solely because settings were saved.

When configuring On, the card exposes only:

- **Inboxes:** select currently qualified work inboxes the manager can administer. Show each actual public team identity and delivery readiness. Restricted or unavailable inboxes have a clear reason and owner repair route, not a misleading enabled checkbox.
- **Invite a random sample:** labelled number input, suffix%, min 1/max 100/step 1, initial 25. Include keyboard increment/decrement and direct entry; no precision slider. Text: “Each eligible conversation has this chance of being selected. Actual invitations may be fewer because contact limits and safety checks still apply.” An illustrative “About 1 in 4 eligible opportunities” updates at 25%, explicitly approximate. Do not show an invented monthly prediction without real source coverage.
- **Reviewed by:** existing eligible coverage destination plus accountable named tenant feedback owner. This records work ownership, not permission grants. No D19 reviewer, CRM owner or guide publisher is auto-promoted.

Below these fields, a quiet “How it works” summary is always accessible: “Wait 24 hours after completed work. Never ask the same mailbox more than once in 30 days. No reminders. No catch-up invitations for old completed work.” It explains that email-only and ambiguous-recipient exclusions mean this is not a survey of every donor. The 24/30 values are fixed launch behavior; the user need does not justify separate knobs for every timer.

**Preview invitation** shows the current governed P17 team template, selected locale and synthetic non-redeemable action, with preview warnings specific to actual missing requirements. **Edit invitation in Email Studio** preserves the policy draft and return location; publishing wording never turns the policy On. An actual external test send uses a separately authorized P17 test contract after implementation; nothing is sent during grooming or by merely opening preview.

Save validates fields in place, announces errors and focuses the first invalid field only on submit. Saving the first On policy opens one concise effect review showing scope, percentage and fixed guarantees. **Enable invitations** admits one versioned command. While saving, retain values and disable duplicate submission. Timeout says “Checking whether the settings were saved”; reconcile the command rather than issuing another activation. After success, show persistent On status and saved-by/time. No toast-only acknowledgement.

Subsequent percentage changes use ordinary Save and explicitly say “Applies to newly completed work; already waiting invitations keep their previous selection setting.” Scope removal cancels definitely-unsubmitted work in that scope. Added inboxes never backfill old completions. Navigation preserves the draft; browser/tenant changes do not accidentally save. Concurrent edits show a revision conflict with current values and preserve the local unsaved proposal for deliberate reconciliation.

### REQ26-D28-UX_BLUEPRINT-S0003 — Turning it Off

Applies to **US26-D28-01**, acceptance **AC26-D28-01-01–03**.

Off has immediate meaning: stop all new automatic invitations and fence pending effects before external submission may begin. The save review states: “Pending invitations will be cancelled. Messages whose submission may already have begun cannot be recalled. Previously issued links remain usable until their original expiry.” The resulting card reads **Off — no new invitations**. Historical ratings remain visible under their source retention policy.

Turning On later is a new sending epoch, never a Resume backlog button. There is no hidden list waiting to be delivered.
