**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** DOCX visible main-document/header/footer content and supported embedded images render legibly with pinned fonts/locale. Missing linked resources, fields, fonts and unsupported features cannot hide behind a successful process/HTTP status.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P06 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** DOCX revisions/comments/hidden text produce the declared no-markup view and known-omission indication without accepting changes or modifying the original. Unknown coverage does not claim complete Ready.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P07 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** PPTX visible slides retain source order/numbering; hidden slides, notes, animation/media and embedded/linked-object omissions are detected and disclosed. Missing content cannot become an unexplained blank slide.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P08 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** XLSX visible sheets/rows/columns retain coordinates and sparse shape, including gaps/filtered rows/all-hidden/empty sheets. A huge declared dimension does not allocate a dense grid; hidden data is counted for parser budgets but not silently shown.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P09 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Formula cache presence/absence is distinguishable. A fixture with intentionally stale cached values shows those exact saved values with Saved values—not recalculated provenance, never a fresh/current-value claim; arbitrary source staleness is not inferred. Missing cached value is unavailable, not zero/blank. External data never refreshes; formulas remain text only.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P10 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Leading zeros, exact large integer/decimal raw values, boolean/error/text cells, currency/percent/date formats and 1900/1904 date-system fixtures preserve meaning. Unsupported formatting shows raw value with limitation, never guessed money/date/timezone facts.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P11 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** XLSX charts/drawings/comments/hidden data and unsupported styles are accurately omitted/disclosed. Pivot definitions/refresh/interactivity are omitted, while visible saved pivot-result cells remain in the grid with no refresh. Print-area settings cannot silently restrict the saved-value view or expose hidden sheets through whole-sheet PDF export.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P12 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** TXT UTF-8 optional BOM and UTF-16 BOM decode correctly; malformed/unsupported encoding is explicitly unavailable. Escaped HTML/XML/JS, bidi controls and filenames cannot affect app DOM or navigation.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P13 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** CSV Comma/Semicolon/Tab choices preserve quotes, embedded newlines, empty/trailing fields, leading zeros and literal formula-looking values. No first-row removal, type/date inference or formula execution. Ragged/malformed table falls back truthfully to independently qualified text.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P14 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Delimiter/profile/source-byte changes create correct distinct projection identities; identical opens coalesce, no cross-tenant reuse and no wrong delimiter result from cache.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P15 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Actual input boundaries20 MiB ±1byte, cumulative expanded200 MiB ±1,10,000-entry boundary, XML-depth 128 boundary, duplicate/path-traversal members, DTD/entities, nested archives and decompression storms stop safely. Count real streamed expansion, not metadata only.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P16 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Actual output boundaries200 pages/slides,40,000,000pixels,256 MiB decoded image working data,50 total sheets,100,000 populated cells including hidden,1,000,000Unicode scalars and50 MiB outputs ±1 do not truncate into a fake complete result.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P17 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Parser descendants are actually limited to60 elapsed seconds, 30 aggregate CPU seconds, 2 GiB memory and 512 MiB scratch; early kill/timeout cleans/fences outputs. Host/API workers and other tenants remain responsive.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P18 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Hostile URL/file/UNC/external relationship, PDF/font/image/parser exploit fixtures cannot reach network, credentials, host paths, application session/DOM or other tenant scratch. Prove network denial at infrastructure boundary, not only converter flags.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P19 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** MIME/extension/signature disagreement, macro-enabled disguised OOXML, encrypted content, corrupt packages and hygiene-pending/failed/blocked sources cannot bypass the declared profile. A conversion/library parse success is not file safety evidence.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P20 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Actual full/range/conditional/private-byte endpoints reauthorize source, tenant and purpose. No reusable public/signed-provider URL or public email-assets path appears in DOM/API/download/redirect responses; response caching cannot bypass restriction.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P21 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Source removal/expiry/reclassification races queueing, input fetch, output upload, Ready promotion, every range read and client reconnection. Stale outputs stay cleanup-only, current clients invalidate, and no old response restores removed content.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P22 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Original source retention never extends from open/retry/cache hit/profile change/merge/restore. Ready24 h and temporary15 min deadlines use correct fixed anchors, source earlier limits and hold custody. Reads do not renew them. After expiry, a deliberate new eligible admission creates a new technical generation under the same input key; concurrent opens coalesce it, old receipts/deadlines remain unchanged, and an expired source cannot regenerate.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P23 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** CRM record → same authorized Support source → viewer → Support → CRM return preserves draft/focus/scroll; no copied CRM file/person/task/Activity event or new audience is created.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P24 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Shared email/unidentified requester/on-behalf organization/contact merge/link/unlink/permission changes do not establish identity or access. Support conversation merge/Undo preserves original attachment restrictions; no cross-source visibility inheritance.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P25 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Opening a receipt-like PDF or value grid performs no giving/receipt/refund/recurring/contact/care approval/update. Viewer close changes no Support status or business completion. Owning-domain actions retain their own positive/negative authorization tests.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P26 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Preview/set-up/ready/retry/read/download creates zero new P17/P6 preparation/send/catalog effects; original/rendition is not silently attached to a reply or published as reusable material/public email asset.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P27 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** No P18 official-document publication/request/issuance/current PDF or archive/signature-validation fact is created by conversion. P18 renderer contest and existing generated-document history remain unchanged.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P28 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** No TipTap content import, recipient/signature/work-intent mutation, D24 shortcut effect or extra D29 form upload/portal archive appears. Later deliberate existing attachment reuse rechecks exact original/asset authority and audience.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P29 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Find within this preview covers the entire declared represented authorized content, including a match on a not-yet-displayed later page/sheet. No matches requires completed scope; interrupted retrieval reports Search incomplete, image-only input is nonsearchable. No hidden content, other files, D22 content indexing, OCR/AI corpus or private query-term logging.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P30 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Genuine SQL/RLS/storage grants, USING/WITH CHECK, policy combinations, composite FKs, immutable result fields, view/function privilege/search-path and service-role negative tests reject forged tenant/source/profile/actor/owner/result promotion.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P31 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Coalesced concurrent opens, duplicate jobs/callbacks, lost admit/publish responses, expired claims and changed input under same identity produce one semantic result or a clear conflict. Storage upload alone never equals Ready; lower-generation output never wins.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P32 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Fault injection between source/intent/audit commits and each blob write/promotion leaves atomic source state or owned tentative cleanup. Promotion transfers accepted output from the15 min tentative sweeper to Ready/source-bounded custody atomically. Cleanup-claim/promotion races have one winner; stale tentative cleanup cannot delete Ready bytes, deletion-claimed output cannot promote, and keys are never reused. Orphan private keys recover from pre-I/O inventory, never Ready by discovery alone.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P33 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Deterministic invalid/oversized/unsupported files do not retry; transient work receives at most the declared second attempt. Exhausted generation creates persistent repair state; ordinary repeated opens cannot create unlimited fresh attempts. Qualified operator repair records a fresh audited generation after cause correction.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P34 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Real logs/traces/error reports/queue payloads/backups/export fixtures comply with purpose and retention: no body/cell/name/raw-URL/token in technical telemetry; file access audit is separate and source-permission protected.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P35 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Mixed old/new code/schema/profile deployments, metadata-only/local/public-URL legacy records and rollback do not invent byte readiness or re-enable unguarded readers. Known retained bytes migrate under current owner authority; otherwise repairable unavailable state remains.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P36 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Profile/worker kill switch stops unsafe new generation/serving while retaining source fences, cleanup/history and unrelated Support. Profile patch invalidates unsafe prior renditions as needed and does not rewrite original bytes or silently change admitted engine lineage.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P37 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Keyboard, screen-reader and touch users can open, navigate, inspect represented data, read limitations, download when allowed, and close to the exact trigger. Virtualized grid has equivalent coordinate-preserving reading; chrome works at 200% zoom / 320px width, RTL, both themes, high contrast and reduced motion.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P38 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** Source corpus includes international names/RTL/CJK, missing fonts, image-only PDFs, source reading-order gaps and ordinary documents. No fabricated accessible transcript/alt text; product controls remain accessible. Staff tests verify they distinguish original, limited preview, saved value and business authority.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P39 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** accepted healthy-load qualification:100 simultaneous opens across 20 tenants,80 repeats across 5 same-source files and 20 distinct cold files (each≤2MiB,≤10pages or1,000cells). Verify coalescing, current authorization, tenant fairness, p95 admission≤1s and cold readiness≤60s with declared worker capacity; warm first-content API response≤2s. Record browser/network separately. These are unmeasured engineering targets, not current capacity.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002-P40 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Required outcome / positive, negative or boundary case:** With 400 kbps / 300 ms round trip and 320px mobile viewport, reader/draft remains usable during partial loading/retry; no all-file eager fetch or automatic download. Separately test maximal admitted files, deliberate overload and one-tenant skew: ceilings hold, queue/recovery is visible, and other tenants remain serviceable. Staff task observations must show a successful same-conversation/CRM return and correct failure/limitation understanding.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0002 — Forty falsifiable release groups

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

Numeric ceilings and load targets are accepted engineering choices. Tests must record exact build/profile/fonts/tzdb or locale dependencies where relevant, schema/grants, deployment limits, hardware/worker capacity, input corpus and observed results. A limit below a provider input allowance is a preview constraint, not permission to change the accepted intake/send contract. A product claim may be revised explicitly from measured evidence, never silently reported as passed.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0003-O01 — Six residual-risk operating controls

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Signal / threshold:** Any confirmed unauthorized source/range retrieval, parser network/host escape or cross-tenant contamination; threshold 1.

**Required response:** Disable affected profile/serving path, preserve source fences and incident evidence, repair and rerun actual isolation/authorization corpus before reactivation. Do not switch to public/raw URLs.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0003-O02 — Six residual-risk operating controls

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Signal / threshold:** Any tentative scratch/output beyond15 min or Ready rendition served beyond its effective source/24 h deadline; threshold 1.

**Required response:** Fence serving/promotion, reconcile exact pre-I/O inventory, perform owner-qualified cleanup and repair the permanent deadline/recovery path. Investigate source restriction propagation.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0003-O03 — Six residual-risk operating controls

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Signal / threshold:** Any confirmed false-complete preview, silent changed numeric value, hidden-content exposure or missing manifest for a material omission; threshold 1.

**Required response:** Disable the affected profile/feature where needed, preserve original evidence, fix projection/coverage and rerun held-out fidelity cases. Do not solve it with a generic disclaimer alone.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0003-O04 — Six residual-risk operating controls

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Signal / threshold:** p95 admission>1s or healthy small-file readiness>60s for15 min with≥100 operations, or a tenant continuously starved for>5 min while other work progresses.

**Required response:** Inspect coalescing/queues/resource claims and worker capacity; apply fair backpressure, preserve source restrictions and fix/remeasure. Slow work does not become failed/ready fiction.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0003-O05 — Six residual-risk operating controls

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Signal / threshold:** Any generation remains queued/running without an owned next attempt or terminal outcome after 5 min, or more than two automatic parser attempts occur.

**Required response:** Reconcile the original generation/claim and repair state; no blind duplicate processing. Operator requeue requires a corrected cause, fresh audited generation and current source authority.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0003-O06 — Six residual-risk operating controls

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Signal / threshold:** Any reproducible inaccessible represented-content/control journey, or≥3 confirmed context-loss/preview-download confusion reports in 30 days.

**Required response:** Correct the shared reader flow, reproduce with the affected assistive technology/device and repeat staff tasks. Keep original access subject to policy; do not add unrelated editor/settings features as a workaround.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0003 — Six residual-risk operating controls

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

These name responsibilities; actual accountable people/on-call coverage must be assigned before activation. Security/fidelity/authority gates remain preventive release requirements, not risks accepted merely by monitoring.

Technical telemetry contains safe operation/profile/status/size/budget measurements. Source/file access audit records actual purpose/actor under its owner. Neither creates a new CRM interaction or per-file Email Studio notification. An authorized worker may report a rendering issue with a safe source reference; do not automatically upload private files to a vendor bug tracker.

### REQ26-D32-PROOF_AND_OPERATIONS-S0004 — Ordered implementation and release

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

2. Map the matrix and R01–R28 to OpenSpec/design/tasks/tickets and P01–P40 without cloning shared file/CRM/generated-document owners.
3. Establish real immutable source custody, hygiene and current-authorized private delivery. Inventory/fence static/local/public-URL paths before protected preview data is active.
4. Implement one isolated shared profile pipeline, atomic intent/Ready promotion, manifests and fixed-deadline cleanup. Qualify candidate exact builds/font/options; do not assume existing DocRaptor/PDF generation wrappers meet the contract.
5. Implement the shared reader and every selected lane, with both ordinary and exception/CRM/mobile/AT journeys. Empty/unavailable/limited are real outcomes; a fake complete partial result is not acceptable.
6. Execute actual security/fidelity/resource/recovery/migration/user proof and the healthy/maximal/overload corpus. Activate a controlled tenant/profile scope with assigned six-control coverage; an A-only pilot is not C completion.
7. Profile disablement/rollback preserves original bytes, restrictions, cleanup and unrelated Support work. Roll-forward corrections generate new qualified rendition lineage; no original rewrite or legacy access escape.

### REQ26-D32-EMAIL_STUDIO_INTEGRATION-S0002 — Each owner's role

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Authority                                         | Owns                                                                                                            | Does not acquire through Preview                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Support Hub                                       | Original message/attachment occurrence, conversation work and current source restrictions.                      | CRM/financial/care truth, official document issuance or unrestricted byte access.                     |
| Shared Phase29-compatible file/preview capability | Immutable bytes, private delivery, hygiene, access audit, isolated technical reading renditions and cleanup.    | Source business meaning, retention purpose, recipient audience or official/current-document identity. |
| CRM/party domains                                 | People, households, organizations, relationships, record access and actual domain mutations.                    | Automatic copies of Support files, implied identity from a file/email, or broader Support visibility. |
| P17 / Email Studio                                | Governed email authoring/presentation, approved reusable material and source-qualified outbound preparation.    | Ownership of received attachment previews or permission to put them in a public image bucket.         |
| P6 delivery                                       | Actual authorized communication dispatch, outcomes and reconciliation.                                          | A new send effect from opening, generating, reading, retrying or downloading a preview.               |
| P18 / Document Studio                             | Governed generated-document publications/facts/requests/issuance, immutable official artifacts and currentness. | Every PDF produced as a temporary reading rendition of received bytes.                                |
| TipTap authoring                                  | Existing qualified reply/note/signature/saved-wording rich text.                                                | A generic Office/PDF editor, content import or preview authoring authority.                           |

### REQ26-D32-EMAIL_STUDIO_INTEGRATION-S0003 — Explicit effects

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

**Preview:** authorizes the actual reader request against its source; may create/reuse one private technical derivative and required access/generation evidence. It never copies the file into CRM, attaches it to a reply, creates a template asset, changes a signature, sends mail or marks the request done.

**Download original:** is a deliberate separately qualified retrieval of the immutable original. It is not a download of the generated preview under the original filename, nor a grant to bypass unscanned/blocked/removed content. It adds no generated official artifact or communication event. Already downloaded data cannot be recalled.

**Later deliberate reply attachment/reuse:** continues through D18/D23/D24 and D4's actual source/asset, audience, preparation and send guards. Existing P17/P6 contracts decide whether the exact bytes may be prepared and sent, including restrictions, consent/purpose, current recipients and irreversible submission. A ready preview is not proof that reuse/send is allowed, and the viewer offers no automatic forwarding shortcut.

**Correction and expiry:** D16/D17 source fences invalidate preview derivatives, rendered text/grids/thumbnails, in-progress jobs and definitely-unsubmitted dependent material under existing contracts. Independent official CRM/giving/Document Studio artifacts keep their own identity and retention. A Support attachment can reference a shared physical byte object without gaining authority to delete another owner's logical document.

**History:** file access/generation events remain file/technical history. Support source evidence remains visible only through the canonical currently authorized original. P6 communication history records actual communication effects, not a new event every time a preview is opened. CRM receives no duplicate person/task/Activity record.

### REQ26-D32-EMAIL_STUDIO_INTEGRATION-S0005 — CRM journey and consequential actions

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

Staff can enter Support from a CRM record, open a currently permitted original attachment, inspect the exact qualified rendition and return to that CRM context. A Support/CRM association does not unlock a care file, financial record or another source conversation. Unknown requesters, shared addresses and represented organizations retain their existing distinct identity/linking rules.

A PDF that resembles a receipt is still requester-supplied evidence unless the owning Document/Giving domain identifies an authoritative artifact. A spreadsheet total is still an unverified saved value. No refund, receipt reissue, recurring-gift change, contact correction, task completion or approval follows from preview success or viewer close. Deliberate business work continues through its owner-authorized action and history.

### REQ26-D32-DATA_CONTRACT-S0002 — Logical records and authoritative ownership

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Record/fact                    | Required meaning                                                                                                                                 | Authority/invariants                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Original attachment occurrence | One file attached to an exact original Support message/source, with current disclosure/retention restrictions.                                   | Support. Tenant-aware source relationship. Equal names or byte digests do not merge occurrences or permissions.                                                                         |
| Original byte version          | Exact immutable bytes, digest, actual length, verified structural type, storage identity, hygiene result/revision and provenance.                | Shared file owner. Provider URL/filename/metadata count is not the byte identity or proof of availability.                                                                              |
| Preview profile revision       | Fixed format/parser/renderer/viewer contract, versions, fonts, settings, feature coverage, security and resource ceilings.                       | Shared file/preview owner. No tenant plugins or silent engine failover.                                                                                                                 |
| Preview intent/generation      | Exact source occurrence + byte version + source restriction generation + profile revision + projection options.                                  | Product-owned shared preview command. One semantic generation; coalesced readers do not multiply jobs or grant rights. CSV delimiter is a projection option, not a personal preference. |
| Attempt                        | Bounded parser/conversion execution, attempt number, trusted system attribution, deadlines, isolated input/output handles and cleanup inventory. | Shared workflow claim/dispatch mechanism. No raw credential, content or arbitrary URL in queue envelopes.                                                                               |
| Ready rendition                | Immutable output-byte IDs/digests and coverage manifest bound to the exact successful generation.                                                | Shared preview/file owner; private and derivative. Technical Ready never supersedes source eligibility.                                                                                 |
| Access evidence                | Authorized view/range/download actor, source/byte version, purpose and technical outcome according to file-owner audit.                          | File/security owner. Not a Support message, new CRM interaction or P6 communication.                                                                                                    |

One source may accumulate different historical profile generations, but ordinary access resolves only an eligible exact generation. Separate the stable source/version/profile/projection input key from the technical generation identity. Expiry retires that generation; a new deliberate eligible admission may create a new generation under the unchanged input key, and concurrent opens coalesce at most one live generation. This never renews the old deadline or changes an old command receipt. Ready blobs are immutable; changing renderer build/options creates new lineage. An original source correction/restriction invalidates current ordinary use across all its derived generations, not just the last one. A source occurrence may reference bytes also used by another owner only through the existing qualified per-owner reference model; deleting one occurrence cannot delete another owner's authoritative receipt or care artifact.

All source/byte/profile/attempt relationships are tenant-aware. Use non-null identity, valid digests/sizes, explicit finite states/generations and conditional unique admission. Store UTC instants for attempts/deadlines without relying on caller-supplied attribution. Do not add finance amounts, copied CRM profiles or editable source values to the preview model. Original file values remain untrusted attached data, not newly authoritative business facts.

### REQ26-D32-DATA_CONTRACT-S0003 — Request → preparation → read

Applies to **US26-D32-06**, acceptance **AC26-D32-06-01–03**.

1. The UI requests Preview for an exact original occurrence in a current authorized conversation/CRM-origin scope. The server derives tenant/actor and resolves current source/bytes/hygiene/policy. It accepts no raw provider URL, output bucket, renderer command or actor/owner field from the caller.
2. If a matching unexpired qualified result exists, the response describes availability; actual bytes still require current authorization. If a matching generation is queued/running, return its status. If no eligible result exists, atomically admit one intent/generation, dispatch/recovery intent and audit correlation.
3. The trusted supervisor fetches only the qualified original through the file owner. Actual streamed byte counts must match allowed bounds; an absent or changed object cannot be silently replaced. The parser receives local read-only input, no credentials or network and a finite scratch/output allowance.
4. Preflight validates the declared format/feature structure and safe limits. The profile creates inert output plus a coverage manifest. A completed process, HTTP200, valid PDF header or storage upload alone is insufficient success.
5. Output lives in private tentative custody. Ready promotion rechecks exact source generation, byte identity, current purpose/eligibility, attempt claim/profile, output digest, limits and manifest. It atomically transfers accepted outputs to Ready custody and its source-bounded deadline; the 15-minute sweeper can delete only remaining scratch/unpromoted outputs. Cleanup and promotion conditionally claim the same immutable object's custody: deletion-claimed output cannot be promoted, and an old tentative claim cannot delete promoted output. Ready expiry has its own guarded disposal path; keys are never reused across generations. If stale/restricted/expired, record cleanup-only disposition and preserve fences. Never publish first and repair authorization later.
6. The reader obtains bounded full/range/page/grid data via the current source-authorized gateway. Conditional/range/cache requests are not authorization shortcuts. Content remains no-store with no reusable provider/storage bearer URL. The browser reader has no application credential/DOM access and only a narrow, validated source-bound data bridge if needed by its isolation model.
7. Closing the viewer is navigation. Source restriction/expiry and current revocation remain enforceable on later requests, client reconnect/visibility return and delayed responses. An old response cannot repopulate a newer restricted view. Already delivered information cannot be remotely recalled.

This is compatible with current shared API owner business ownership and the approved authorized read projections. Shared storage/preview mechanics can be a bounded Phase29-compatible predecessor; C does not wait for the entire future File Manager. There is no app-local binary repository or direct browser lifecycle mutation.

### REQ26-D32-DATA_CONTRACT-S0004 — State and recovery semantics

Applies to **US26-D32-01**, acceptance **AC26-D32-01-01–03**.

Technical lifecycle is admitted/queued → processing → Ready or classified unavailable/failed. Source eligibility is orthogonal and dominates every state. Limited is a truthful coverage condition of a usable qualified rendition, not permission to serve partial corrupt output. Restricted/expired source prevents ordinary generation/use irrespective of stored technical result.

At most two parser attempts are allowed per generation, and only classified transient failures use the second. Unsupported, malformed, malicious/blocked and over-budget inputs do not retry automatically. A timeout is not permission for simultaneous replacement workers; reconcile/fence the prior attempt first. After budget exhaustion, show the persistent processing issue. An authorized operator may deliberately admit an audited replacement generation after correcting the cause and rechecking current source/profile/budgets; ordinary repeated opens cannot bypass the exhausted generation into unlimited work.

Same semantic command identity returns/reconciles the same generation under current disclosure rights. Changed input under the same identity conflicts. Coalescing does not share access between actors or tenants. New source/profile/delimiter inputs create distinct identities. A callback from an old worker cannot promote output under a newer claim/generation, even after the old lease expires.

The source record and required dispatch/cleanup intents must commit atomically. Blob writes are external effects, so staging keys/attempt inventory precede I/O. Partial writes or success with a lost response reconcile exact object identity and cleanup; no orphan can become an authorized file by being present in storage. Use the already-qualified shared workflow ledger/claims/recovery, without a second event engine.

### REQ26-D32-DATA_CONTRACT-S0005 — Profile data behavior

Applies to **US26-D32-03**, acceptance **AC26-D32-03-01–03**.

DOCX/PPTX may use an isolated maintained converter to static pages. Pin fonts/locale/options and classify detected missing fonts/resources, revisions/comments, hidden/embedded media and other unrepresented features. Silent omission of linked content despite a successful response is an explicit known tool behavior to defend against, not a supported fidelity claim. Untrusted external paths/resources remain blocked even when allowing them would make the page look better.

XLSX requires a saved-value extraction profile. Preserve typed raw cell values, coordinates, workbook date system, visible sheet/row/column state and cached-formula presence. Do not use JavaScript float coercion for arbitrary precision/raw values or turn missing `<v>` into zero. Supported style rendering is qualified; unsupported formatting keeps the raw value and a visible limitation. No calculation engine, external link refresh, HTML cell rendering, print-range omission, hidden-sheet export or automatic data import exists.

Text/CSV uses a strict declared decoder and literal parser. A per-view delimiter participates in output identity. Preserve empty cells, leading zeros, quotes/newlines and formula-looking values. No DTD/HTML/URI/formula execution occurs. Any safe text fallback has its own encoding/size qualification and exactly the same source authority.

### REQ26-D32-DATA_CONTRACT-S0006 — Resource units and limits

Applies to **US26-D32-04**, acceptance **AC26-D32-04-01–03**.

These are accepted preview-only engineering ceilings, not universal file-upload or sending limits. `MiB = 1,048,576 bytes`; `GiB = 1,073,741,824 bytes`; megapixels here means decimal pixels. An existing stricter source/provider/purpose limit wins.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Dimension                   | Initial ceiling / exact interpretation                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Original input              | 20 MiB actual streamed bytes per file.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Expanded package data       | 200 MiB cumulative actual uncompressed OOXML/package bytes, including hidden resources. Metadata declarations are preflight only.                                                                      |
| Package structure           | 10,000 entries; depth 128 for XML; no DTD/external entity expansion, archive path traversal, duplicate ambiguous member names or arbitrary nested archive extraction.                                  |
| Pages/slides                | 200 actual output pages or visible slide renditions. Exceeding this yields Too large/unavailable, never first 200 labelled complete.                                                                   |
| Raster limits               | 40,000,000 pixels per decoded image and 256 MiB aggregate decoded-image working data per attempt; total process memory remains separately bounded.                                                     |
| Workbook                    | 50 total sheets, including hidden; 100,000 total populated cells, including hidden. Sparse dimensions are validated but never allocated densely. These limits include inputs parsed even if not shown. |
| Text/CSV                    | 1,000,000 decoded Unicode scalar values; table also capped at 100,000 populated cells. Empty field/row representation remains bounded by input/output limits and chunked parsing.                      |
| Generated outputs           | 50 MiB cumulative ready/tentative output-byte content per generation.                                                                                                                                  |
| Attempt                     | 60 elapsed seconds; 30 aggregate process-tree CPU seconds; 2 GiB aggregate process-tree memory; 512 MiB scratch. Supervisor enforcement covers descendants, not just HTTP timeout.                     |
| Retry                       | At most two attempts per generation; second only for classified transient failure, under unchanged source/profile intent.                                                                              |
| Temporary/tentative custody | Maximum15 elapsed minutes from attempt start, earlier where source/owner disposal requires. Register before I/O.                                                                                       |
| Ready rendition custody     | Maximum24 elapsed hours from first Ready admission, bounded sooner by source expiry/restriction/owner obligations. Reads never renew it.                                                               |

Parser allocation/entry/XML/style/relationship handling must remain bounded before expanding data; size limits are not a substitute for process isolation. Profile qualification must prove high-compression, sparse-sheet, many-empty-cell, deeply nested and huge-dimension behavior. Limits do not justify silently dropping data. A profile may decline a file within the outer size caps when its unsupported features or fidelity cannot be made truthful.

### REQ26-D32-DATA_CONTRACT-S0007 — Security, RLS and retention

Applies to **US26-D32-04**, acceptance **AC26-D32-04-01–03**.

Use least-privilege database/storage grants and RLS. Inspect actual SELECT/USING/WITH CHECK relationships, permissive policy combinations, source/tenant FK constraints, function execution grants, fixed search paths, invoker/definer views/functions and service-role handlers. Server commands alone may mutate generation/status/profile/result/owner/audit fields. A permitted source row must not be transformable into another tenant/owner/version by a client patch.

An `email-assets` bucket explicitly public for exported email images is not a private preview store. Raw short-lived signed URLs also do not satisfy D16's current restriction boundary. Cache invalidation and token expiry do not recall independently delivered bytes. Private full/range delivery and all derived forms must remain tied to current source access with safe response headers and no-store behavior.

No cross-tenant content-digest reuse or side-channel lookup. Jobs use isolated scratch namespaces; clean them between attempts and prevent state leakage through fonts, caches, temporary paths or converter profiles. Operational logs include opaque correlations/status/budgets only, never raw filenames/text/cell values/URLs/tokens. Source and access history use their owners' retention; an error log must not become a secret archive.

The 24 h rendition / 15 min scratch lifetimes are cache/custody product choices, not P17 prepared-message rules or D17's original-content retention. Expired derivatives can be regenerated only from a still-authorized source; original source expiry cannot be reset by previewing, copying, merging, profile change or restore. A hold preserves actual owner-required evidence in restricted custody without restoring ordinary reader access.

### REQ26-D32-DATA_CONTRACT-S0008 — Qualification and migration

Applies to **US26-D32-05**, acceptance **AC26-D32-05-01–03**.

The independent data review records actual current attachment SQL, public bucket and metadata-availability weaknesses. They are release prerequisites, not patched by this document. Inventory legacy references and qualify actual retained immutable bytes before deriving previews; do not fetch arbitrary URLs or invent scan/digest evidence. Mixed versions must fence old raw/public-URL readers before activating protected sources. Restriction/cleanup survives rollback and kill switches.

Run P01–P40 on actual database/RLS/storage/gateway/parser/viewer implementations. Current research and bounded reference probes are not those tests. The permanent ownership and reader architecture are decided in the accepted package; exact implementation builds remain required release evidence.

## Personal Compact/Full reading

### REQ26-D33-R01 — D33-R01 — Selected scope and initial default

Applies to **US26-D33-01**, acceptance **AC26-D33-01-01–03**.

Provide exactly Compact and Full as personal Support email-reading defaults. Confirmed absence of a setting means Compact without an automatic database write. Compact is about repeated content, not smaller typography, compressed spacing, hiding whole messages, changed sort order or fewer records. Full is the same safe currently permitted source without automatic repeated-region folding. Internal notes, work history, active drafts, prepared/send reviews and signature previews retain their existing complete presentation.

### REQ26-D33-R02 — D33-R02 — Personal scope and authoritative owner

Applies to **US26-D33-01**, acceptance **AC26-D33-01-01–03**.

Use one value per current tenant, actual authenticated staff profile and closed Support-reading key in D20's shared personal-preference capability. It follows that person across devices and the qualified Support/CRM reader within that tenant. It is not per inbox/conversation/view, a tenant setting, CRM contact field, authenticated requester preference or impersonated person's profile. Membership/Support-surface eligibility is rechecked; changing a default grants no conversation access. No administrator overrides another person's value through this control.

### REQ26-D33-R03 — D33-R03 — Location and choice semantics

Applies to **US26-D33-01**, acceptance **AC26-D33-01-01–03**.

Place the visible labelled control in the conversation reader's utility header beside Find, separate from Reply, Send and work/status actions. Keep it reachable without scrolling the whole conversation, including the empty reader pane for an otherwise authorized staff member. Menu title: **Your Support reading default**. Choices: **Compact — Fold repeated quoted history and signatures**; **Full — Show complete message content**. Supporting copy: **Only for you in [tenant name]. Changes save automatically.** Exactly one known/default choice is selected; unknown/error state is not displayed as a confirmed saved selection. Use shared Base UI radio-menu semantics, not an empty-capable toggle or new settings page.

### REQ26-D33-R04 — D33-R04 — Temporary disclosure versus saved default

Applies to **US26-D33-01**, acceptance **AC26-D33-01-01–03**.

Label folds **Show quoted history** or **Show repeated signature**, with an accessible expanded state and a corresponding Collapse control. The menu has a separate **This conversation** group with **Expand repeated content** and, when applicable, **Use my default for this conversation**. Temporary expansion never writes the preference. When the conversation-wide temporary command is used, show **Reading: Full · this conversation** and keep the menu's saved-default group accurate. Individual expansions preserve the default label; do not invent a third persisted Mixed mode. Reset clears temporary overrides for this conversation and applies the latest confirmed default, preserving the active search match and focus.

### REQ26-D33-R05 — D33-R05 — Save feedback and failure

Applies to **US26-D33-01**, acceptance **AC26-D33-01-01–03**.

A deliberate default choice changes this reader immediately and saves the absolute value. Show quiet accessible **Saving…**, then **Default saved** only after authoritative confirmation. A definite rejection or unknown/lost response leaves the chosen local view intact with **This view only** and accurate **Could not save** or **Could not confirm your default was saved** copy plus Retry. No modal confirmation, automatic collapse, toast-only recovery, false Saved state or permanent offline queue. Retry first reconciles current state; it never blindly overwrites a newer choice. Selecting the already-displayed value can explicitly confirm that default; simple reading never saves it.

### REQ26-D33-R06 — D33-R06 — Concurrency and idempotency

Applies to **US26-D33-01**, acceptance **AC26-D33-01-01–03**.

Use an absolute Compact/Full command and expected monotonic preference revision, scoped from trusted server context. A fresh deliberate save at the matching revision atomically persists/advances the revision even if the displayed value already matches; absent has virtual revision zero and first save creates a row. This fences stale writes after explicit Compact/reset. A stale repeat whose desired value is already current returns **Already current** and the current revision without a new effect; a different current value yields conflict. No toggle command, blind last-write-wins, delete-to-reset, automatic conflict rebase, durable workflow/outbox or business-event ledger is needed. Serialize local writes; preserve the newest local intent, reject stale responses/rollback and stop queued autosaves on external conflict for explicit retry. See the exact contract and race cases in the data contract.

### REQ26-D33-R07 — D33-R07 — Loading, absent and unavailable are distinct

Applies to **US26-D33-01**, acceptance **AC26-D33-01-01–03**.

The preference does not block authorized conversation reading. Use a correctly scoped confirmed value if available; otherwise start a temporary Compact presentation. A failed/unknown read is not evidence of an absent row: show **Could not load your default. This view only.** No fallback value is automatically saved. Choices can alter local reading while persistence is unavailable; Retry must obtain current revision before any new save. A late fetch or another device's change updates the known default for future entry, not the current reader's active position/disclosures. A brief **Default updated elsewhere** notice may offer deliberate application.

### REQ26-D33-R08 — D33-R08 — Conservative source-preserving folding

Applies to **US26-D33-02**, acceptance **AC26-D33-02-01–03**.

Build an expendable versioned display-segment map over the same current qualified safe source; never rewrite, remove or replace original text. A received quotation marker, closing-shaped tail, sender identity or D22 search-normalized match alone is insufficient. Auto-fold only a whole structurally bounded quote region whose complete rendered meaning is established as repeated against a currently permitted earlier source in the same qualified conversation context. Any inline edit, changed/uncertain portion or first/only forwarded context stays open as a whole. Do not build word-level speculative diff folding or call an uncertain extraction the new answer.

### REQ26-D33-R09 — D33-R09 — Equality and signature boundaries

Applies to **US26-D33-02**, acceptance **AC26-D33-02-01–03**.

Repetition comparison preserves meaningful text, whitespace, case, links and targets, images/qualified asset identity, alternative text, tables and semantic formatting such as deletion/strikethrough. Different hrefs or changed values cannot fold as equal because displayed words match. A received/manual standalone signature without a qualified boundary remains visible. A structurally identified D23-generated historical signature may fold only when its actual historical rendered content repeats currently permitted earlier content; a current profile/template is not proof of historical equality. First/unique contact details remain visible. Quote-only/signature-only messages keep their sole substantive body visible rather than becoming an apparently empty response. No external resource fetch, cross-tenant comparison, hidden earlier source or live P17 lookup is allowed to establish repetition.

### REQ26-D33-R10 — D33-R10 — Full presentation and safe fallback

Applies to **US26-D33-02**, acceptance **AC26-D33-02-01–03**.

Full exposes all eligible body content within the existing bounded source-loading contract, without automatically fetching every historical body, attachment or remote image. It is not raw MIME/HTML, a second renderer with weaker rules or a redaction bypass. Segmentation uncertainty/failure shows the affected qualified full content. If full rendering itself fails, show a truthful failure and qualified text fallback when available, never blank-success or raw unsafe markup. Attachment-only messages remain valid and show their qualified attachment controls. Unsupported content is identified, not silently discarded.

### REQ26-D33-R11 — D33-R11 — Preserve context and important chrome

Applies to **US26-D33-03**, acceptance **AC26-D33-03-01–03**.

Sender/recipient/audience, message kind, timestamp, delivery state and qualified attachment states/actions stay outside repeat folds. Use the same chronological source order. Expanding/collapsing or choosing a default preserves the current message anchor, keyboard focus, conversation draft, recipients, staged work and return context. A collapse containing focus moves focus predictably to its disclosure trigger before content unmounts. Do not move Send under the pointer or reset another open fold through background hydration.

### REQ26-D33-R12 — D33-R12 — Complete Find and exact navigation

Applies to **US26-D33-03**, acceptance **AC26-D33-03-01–03**.

D22 source matching, no repeated-text ranking boost, authorization gaps and complete conversation Find remain unchanged. A search/Find result reveals and focuses/highlights its exact currently eligible source region even if folded or not mounted. Search expansion is temporary; clearing Find does not abruptly re-collapse the inspected region. A later deliberate reset may restore Compact except for the active match/focus. Browser-native find/hidden-until-found can supplement but never substitute for D22's authorized full search scope. Folding cannot create false no-matches or join text across hidden sources.

### REQ26-D33-R13 — D33-R13 — Access, source changes and lifetime

Applies to **US26-D33-04**, acceptance **AC26-D33-04-01–03**.

Authorize each original source/projection under current tenant and source restrictions before display, expansion, Find or cached reuse. D16/D17 restriction/expiry and current loss of access override all reading modes, render maps and delayed responses. A source generation/restriction change invalidates affected maps/overrides; a newly full fallback is still authorized first. Comparison evidence from an earlier source is not permission to read it. Merge/Undo/reopen/CRM linking preserve original identity and invalidate stale context-dependent maps; they neither reset the personal default nor resurrect removed content.

### REQ26-D33-R14 — D33-R14 — Closed preference data invariants

Applies to **US26-D33-04**, acceptance **AC26-D33-04-01–03**.

Require non-null tenant/profile/closed key, Compact/Full check, monotonic nonnegative virtual/positive persisted revision and trusted update time. Enforce one logical row per scope and tenant-aware membership relationship; do not create money, party linkage, content body or owner-config fields. Reset is an explicit Compact write, not row deletion/ABA. Account/tenant deletion follows the shared personal-data owner, independently of Support message retention; removing a preference cannot delete business history. Membership loss immediately blocks ordinary reads/writes, with qualified lifecycle cleanup instead of per-inbox duplicates.

### REQ26-D33-R15 — D33-R15 — Supabase and API qualification

Applies to **US26-D33-04**, acceptance **AC26-D33-04-01–03**.

Derive actual tenant/profile/actor/key from authenticated server context and a closed command, not caller-supplied identity or editable JWT metadata. Reuse the approved API/data-read boundary. Preserve least-privilege grants and RLS with explicit current-owner/source checks for SELECT and both UPDATE old-row/new-row semantics; immutable scope fields cannot be retargeted. Examine permissive policy combinations, invoker/definer behavior, execution grants and service-role bypass explicitly. No browser service key, generic settings-object write, CRM table-ID spoofing or assumption that RLS protects a privileged path. Actual current preference routes/helpers require additive qualification before reuse.

### REQ26-D33-R16 — D33-R16 — Cache and navigation state

Applies to **US26-D33-04**, acceptance **AC26-D33-04-01–03**.

Preference cache keys include tenant, real profile and closed key; body/segment keys include tenant, current original source/restriction generation and renderer/segment version. No SSR/CDN/shared-user cache or browser storage of content just to remember reading mode. Default and current-session overrides are distinct. Back from file preview/CRM in the same authorized navigation session restores safe message anchors and disclosure state; a fresh conversation entry or reload uses the confirmed default. Switching tenant/profile clears prior scope before rendering; stale responses cannot repopulate it. Reconnect/visibility return revalidates access and known defaults without surprising active-reader reshaping.

### REQ26-D33-R17 — D33-R17 — CRM and business-domain continuity

Applies to **US26-D33-03**, acceptance **AC26-D33-03-01–03**.

Use the same authorized Support reader and personal preference through CRM. Requester, participant, authenticated profile, Party/CRM record, represented organization, Support assignee and CRM owner remain distinct. Matching email is not identity or access proof. Preference/folding actions create no person, link, task, Activity, file copy, giving change or business completion. Link/unlink/merge/deletion permission changes are handled by existing owners; inaccessible context is not revealed in folded labels, counts or cache metadata.

### REQ26-D33-R18 — D33-R18 — Email Studio and rich-text seam

Folding does not change outgoing quoted-body inclusion, recipients, headers, signature/legal footer, reply mode, D24 plan, attachment reuse or prepared snapshot. Applies to **US26-D33-04**, acceptance **AC26-D33-04-01–03**.

Body text retains normal Core size/line height in both modes. Reflow/text zoom/RTL/CJK/Thai/long names, display timezone and low-bandwidth reading must work. No hover-only information, colour-only status, icon-only mystery control, focusable collapsed descendants, height animation or long-motion scroll. Shared Maia tokens and existing reduced-motion rules apply.

### REQ26-D33-R21 — D33-R21 — Bounded work and performance

Applies to **US26-D33-04**, acceptance **AC26-D33-04-01–03**.

Do not classify the entire corpus on each toggle, query all earlier bodies without bounds or render thousands of editors. Reuse exact safe source projections, bounded progressive loading and cancellable/memoized segmentation keyed by current lineage; cache failure never creates unsafe reuse. Record finite byte/node/depth/comparison-window/time budgets in the qualified segment profile and test below/at/above them; exceeding any budget yields full permitted content, never truncation or a background retry storm. This implementation safety manifest is required before activation and does not change intake/retention limits. accepted release fixtures and measurable interaction budgets are in P31–P33; no production capacity claim is made.

A preference change is not durable Support/CRM business history and needs no per-click audit event or notification. Security/source access history remains with its existing owner. Use O01–O06's named signals, thresholds, owners and responses. A fallback that preserves full content is not automatically a privacy incident; false repetition classification or scope leakage is a material defect.

### REQ26-D33-R23 — D33-R23 — Migration and rollback

Preserve originals before enabling segmentation; inventory any historically stripped/missing source and disclose unavailability rather than invent restoration. Deploy qualified full renderer, preference boundary, segment rules and UI together behind a narrow rollout gate. A segment kill switch shows qualified Full while retaining the saved choice; rollback never re-enables unsafe source rendering or drops new preference rows/revisions. No migration to ReUI or whole-shell redesign is required.
