Unknown discard stays an original-operation recovery state; it cannot coexist with an unsafe fresh same-slot creation. Discard cannot cancel a possibly admitted Add note. Once the actual result is known, return focus to the remaining row, next eligible row or My drafts heading predictably.

Clearing the entire content of an existing saved Note is a normal candidate update, not implicit Discard. Retain the stable draft until deliberate terminal action and show **No note content yet** where it explains the row. Merely opening a fresh empty Note still creates nothing. This follows D37's prevention of phantom drafts and silent loss without a new cleanup timer.

### REQ26-D38-UX_BLUEPRINT-S0012 — UX10 — Editing a posted note stays different

Applies to **US26-D38-03**, acceptance **AC26-D38-03-01–03**.

D35's **Edit note → Save changes / Cancel → Edited / View history** remains local, deliberate and out of My drafts. Do not rename its Save changes to Add note, autosave revisions, create a persistent correction draft, add new mentions/files through that correction flow or notify on routine edits. If a posted-note edit and a new Note draft exist in one reader, their separate states and actions remain unambiguous; canceling one cannot discard the other.

### REQ26-D38-UX_BLUEPRINT-S0013 — State copy and recovery

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| State                                                | Clear response                                                                                                                                         |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| No saved work of either kind                         | **No drafts yet. Replies and internal notes you start in a conversation appear here after saving.** Return to Support conversations; no setup wizard.  |
| One purpose missing                                  | Simply omit that nonexistent row. No empty Note/Reply section, disabled placeholder or count is needed.                                                |
| Filter has no results                                | Explain the current title/inbox scope and offer Clear search or All accessible inboxes. Do not claim no private work exists elsewhere.                 |
| New meaningful work awaiting acknowledgment          | **Saving** or **Not saved**, bound to this Note; no false Saved from the other purpose.                                                                |
| Text checkpoint acknowledged, attachment still local | Truthful text/draft status plus **Attachment uploading/not saved**; use the combined leave guard when needed.                                          |
| Save failure                                         | **Couldn't save this note draft.** Preserve safe work and offer Retry save.                                                                            |
| Unknown save                                         | **Checking save** / **Save status unknown**, original-operation recovery and an honest leave path.                                                     |
| Different tab changed it                             | **This note draft changed elsewhere.** Preserve allowed local work; deliberately review/reapply or load current saved content without blind overwrite. |
| Source destination changed                           | **Review where this note will be added**, with the exact permitted current consequence. No silent rehome.                                              |
| Missing current read authority                       | Qualified unavailable state; no forbidden title, body, file name, mention or Copy escape.                                                              |
| Publication rejected before admission                | Preserve the active draft and explain the actionable current cause.                                                                                    |
| Publication uncertain                                | **Checking whether your note was added.** Do not present another fresh Add note or ordinary disposable draft until original admission is settled.      |
| Publication confirmed                                | **Note added.** One source note; exact draft consumed; other purpose unchanged.                                                                        |

Microcopy is the accepted interaction language, not a promise that unavailable owner information can always be displayed. Localize copy and dates; do not infer relationships from a person's name, translated title or email.

### REQ26-D38-UX_BLUEPRINT-S0015 — Visual and technical discipline

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Use shared Base UI/base-maia, existing semantic tokens, readable normal body text, restrained metadata and clear focus. Reuse menus/dialogs and existing active editor; no app-local theme, color-only audience cue, animated save celebration or Tiptap history/comments/collaboration service. A list refresh does not mount note editors or prefetch private bodies. Dark mode, touch and reduced motion retain the same hierarchy.

Important status is available to assistive technology without moving focus or narrating each keystroke. Actual controls have names and appropriate roles; don't wrap a separate More action inside a row link. A dismissed menu restores focus; a consumed/discarded row chooses a predictable next target. An accessible input label is not replaced by placeholder text. These outcomes require runtime verification, as explained by W3C status guidance.

Support owns private Note persistence, exact source purpose, Save and Add note admission. P17's shared editor/schema and qualified reusable wording retain their role; saving/restoring a note does not prepare email or publish a template. A separately admitted post-derived attention email follows its existing P17 purpose and P6 transport. External Reply preparation, immutable sent material and P6 reconciliation remain unchanged. No notebook, second CRM, provider draft sync, new financial action, internal-email channel or general workflow is introduced.

The consolidated D38 requirements, data/editor review and proof plan must bind these UX outcomes to actual owner constraints. The detailed amendments are fully ratified and incorporated here. No runtime, authenticated vendor visual trial or staff-task pass is claimed here.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0005 — C01 — One private owner, distinct immutable purposes

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Extend the existing D37 private Support draft aggregate to admit two closed purposes, external Reply and new Internal note. Purpose is fixed at creation. Enforce at most one active draft per trusted tenant, real owner, immutable original working slot and purpose. A person can retain a Reply and a Note for the same original at once; each has its own stable ID, revision and operation generation. Switching tabs/mode resumes its existing draft without converting, overwriting or publishing the other purpose.

This is a bounded purpose discriminator, not a generic workflow platform. Physical table names and enum spellings can follow the qualified implementation. Reuse storage/commands/receipts/metadata queries and the authoring coordinator where their behavior is actually identical; purpose-specific schema and admission must remain explicit. A posted-note correction under D35 is a different operation against a published source, never a third My drafts purpose inferred by this decision.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0006 — C02 — Actual keys and source affinity

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Retain actual UUID tenant/auth/profile/membership relationships and actual TEXT Support source/message/agent IDs. A draft's immutable origin is its private slot. A new general note's intended publication original follows D10-R14's then-current continuing original or an already-qualified explicit source-specific action. Capture that intended destination and the relevant topology/source revision for visible current review. Merge/Undo/movement cannot silently reparent the private draft, choose a new destination, merge slots or post under stale source authority.

Origin, current workspace root and publication source may need separate references; do not overload one conversation_id. On a material change, preserve permitted writing, show the current proposed destination and require the established source/context review before Post. No new arbitrary move/copy-note workflow is selected. Revalidate every required origin/publication/dependency floor, and preserve the resulting actual source on the published note and its D35 revision history.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0007 — C03 — Structurally enforce valid data

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

The draft requires non-null tenant, trusted owner/profile, origin, purpose, schema/profile version, stable generation, positive current revision and authoritative UTC create/meaningful-save times. Same-tenant composite PK/FK or equivalent uniquely constrained endpoints bind draft, source, file occurrences, dependencies, operation receipts and its eventual published-note result. Partial uniqueness covers active slots by purpose. Terminal generations cannot be revived through generic UPDATE, DELETE or old-create replay.

For notes, external email target/audience/headers, email signature/publication and delivery intent fields are structurally absent or forbidden, rather than silently accepted then ignored. Legitimate note mentions and source references have their own qualified typed structures. A valid incomplete Note may save before it is postable; unsupported nodes, arbitrary raw HTML or forged provenance are not mere incompleteness. Closed JSON/profile validation precedes parsing. Known size/depth/node/asset limits are applied before costly normalization; final actual numeric limits come from the shared qualified profile, not a new guessed allowance.

Use CHECK/NOT NULL/unique/FK constraints for row-local invariants and command/transaction checks for current membership/source/retention/cross-row rules. A CHECK that queries mutable other rows is not a sound substitute for authoritative concurrency control. Do not cascade draft cleanup into conversation, CRM, published note, revision or independently owned files. This feature adds no money fields or numeric money precision change.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0008 — C04 — Trusted current actor and complete private read scope

Applies to **US26-D38-01**, acceptance **AC26-D38-01-01–03**.

Every list/open/create/save/discard/post/recovery operation derives current authenticated principal, real durable owner/profile, selected tenant and active permitted membership from Core's shared server context. The source owner verifies relevant current read/write/post capabilities and purpose. Ignore or reject caller owner/author/tenant/role/approval/publication/clock fields. Email similarity, current assignee, conversation membership and ordinary administrative role never grant another person's draft.

Do not accidentally enforce `profiles.tenant_id = selectedTenant` if legitimate current multi-tenant membership is the actual platform mapping. Do not assume profile ID equals auth user ID. API context remains necessary on service paths; a pooled caller-set custom GUC, browser `current_setting`, user_metadata, stale claims alone or in-memory tenant string is not independently trusted identity. Current source revocation/retention checks remain effective at every authoritative operation, not only initial route entry.

Read, save, discard and Post have operation-specific capabilities. Losing Post permission alone does not remove still-lawful owner inspection/custody: allow the currently permitted saved representation to be read with Add note unavailable. Conversely, private ownership/read access cannot grant composition, update or publication authority. A general source/privacy loss still removes every newly forbidden representation, including stale cache/Undo material.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0009 — C05 — Grants, RLS, views, functions and every access route

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Canonical multi-table draft/save/post work stays in the shared API owner commands behind thin authenticated routes. No raw anon/authenticated DML may change private draft bodies or immutable control fields outside these commands. Use the qualified D37 private relation and approved browser metadata read boundary; do not add the Note purpose to broad published-message policies.

Enable RLS on exposed draft/dependency/receipt relations and preserve Core's qualified FORCE-RLS/tenant-guard posture where applicable, while recognizing bypass-role limits. Grant only required read surfaces and execute operations; ordinary clients receive no blanket private-body CRUD, TRUNCATE, role-changing or schema-changing authority. Audit effective permissive OR/restrictive AND policies, inherited grants and default privileges, SELECT/USING/new-row WITH CHECK behavior, column update permissions, view settings, API/GraphQL/exposure, SECURITY DEFINER owner/search_path/EXECUTE, and every service worker path. Restrict helper/schema exposure without assuming non-exposed means unreachable to a granted SQL role. Grant changes and function creation occur atomically during the later migration.

With service-role command execution, validate the real actor and current source explicitly before privileged access and again at the effect boundary as needed. Never expose service keys. Middleware or PostgREST-specific pre-request checks cannot establish Storage/Realtime/other-consumer parity; each actual route must enforce the same permission. A read-only metadata view is not safe if a dependent helper or cached projection leaks body/identity. Constraint errors and conflict responses must not disclose another person's slot/note/source existence. Supabase API security

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0010 — C06 — Atomic complete note-draft saves

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Save canonical Note document, admitted mention/source references, file-selection state and the narrow actually allowed note context as one versioned effect. Saving never calls addPrivateNote, adds a timeline row, notifies a mention/follower, changes work state, updates last contact/native content clocks, prepares mail or executes a shortcut. A saved attachment manifest does not prove local File bytes are uploaded.

D37 whole-bundle no-op/ACK rules apply per purpose. One conditional save advances only its matching draft version, with latest meaningful-save time only on a semantic change; no-op still has an immutable operation outcome. An earlier ACK cannot mark later typing Saved or touch the other mode's state. No staged Reply actions or generic arbitrary work-plan blob is admitted into the Note bundle.

**D24-R01/R10 resolution:** there is no internal-note-and-work mode in this scope. The Note schema excludes staged Reply work plans, external audience, signature and email-send state; switching modes leaves the separate Reply plan intact and carries none of it into the Note. Purpose-qualified note wording, ordinary files and typed mentions remain the existing allowed note capabilities, not a generic plan consumer.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0011 — C07 — Post is one atomic local admission

Applies to **US26-D38-03**, acceptance **AC26-D38-03-01–03**.

Post note revalidates the exact reviewed Note draft revision, current actor, final original source, canonical profile, attachments, mentions and source privacy/retention. One authoritative database transaction admits one native human internal note, its first D35-compatible canonical revision/current head and trusted original author/publication attribution; consumes the exact private draft generation; records the immutable post-operation result; applies the source owner's required native-content/aggregate facts; and commits the required identifier-only occurrence/outbox obligations. Any rejection before admission publishes nothing and preserves the permitted draft.

Posting is not an external email. The note is structurally internal and may become visible only to currently authorized staff, including through CRM Support context. It never gains external recipients/headers/transport identity merely because legacy code uses delivered flags. The returned posted result means the local note was admitted; it does not claim staff notices were delivered or business actions finished. If optional follower/direct-mention consumers are unavailable, durable source obligations permit recovery without reposting the note or blocking on an external provider. Existing owners decide which actual consumers apply.

Postability requires meaningful qualified canonical body **or at least one ready, clean, currently permitted selected attachment**. Attachment-only notes need no dummy text. Incomplete drafts, including pending-file-only candidates, may save, but a still-selected pending/failed/unsafe file cannot be silently dropped at Post: finish it or deliberately remove it. Typed mentions that form meaningful authored content remain subject to the same canonical note validation; saving the mention does not notify anyone. This corrects the current UI's attachment-aware dirty state versus actual Note request's omitted files, without adding an upload surface or relaxing file safety.

Native-note publication is one D17-R05 admission event, not every autosave or edit. Process elapsed source expiry/frontier before admitting new content under current lawful purpose; neither worker lag nor a new note rehydrates old expired content. Use row locks/revision guards or equivalent qualified serialization over shared source/privacy/topology facts, not an app-side check followed by an unguarded insert. Transactionally increment or derive counters instead of current read-plus-one arithmetic.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0012 — C08 — First publication versus D35 history

Applies to **US26-D38-03**, acceptance **AC26-D38-03-01–03**.

The published note keeps one stable source-owned note ID and trustworthy native-human author and first-admission time. Its first canonical revision becomes the D35 Original only with proven original provenance. Private draft checkpoints are not posted revisions or audit copies; posting cannot expose all earlier unsent wording to colleagues. Later Edit note follows D35's explicit author-owned correction command, not autosaving to the private new-note slot.

Unknown old HTML/JSON/source/author lineage is migration/repair material, not an invented Original or authorship recovered from email text. The posted note and private draft may have different retention/discovery grants. Consume the private aggregate without deleting independently admitted published evidence. Do not move caller-supplied raw HTML directly into the first revision or route system/macro-generated notes through the native-human publication provenance simply because they display as notes today.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0013 — C09 — Durable idempotency, concurrency and operation access

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Bind create/save/discard/post operation identity to tenant, real owner, purpose, original slot, draft generation, expected revision, current authority/source fences and exact semantic command. Same key with changed purpose/payload conflicts. Current authorized replay returns the original minimal outcome; it never repeats publication, initial revision, activity or downstream admission. Receipt/material cache expiration does not release an identity while an old request or restored client could still cause that effect.

Race two first saves, two tabs, save versus Post, discard versus Post, lost acknowledgments and old-create replay. Active-slot uniqueness and exact conditional transitions allow one winner without cross-purpose overwrites. Confirmed Post consumes only the matching Note draft; its sibling Reply remains. Unknown Post is the original local operation under recovery, not a new editable Post again affordance. An absent lookup is not definite nonacceptance until late admission is fenced; canceled HTTP is not rollback. Keep body-free original handles through supported navigation, with current read/disclosure checks before returning even result IDs. Deliberate fresh note after completion uses a new generation, not recycled receipt identity. No user-facing draft history or per-keystroke event store is required.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0014 — C10 — Source-derived content, privacy and expiry

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

D16/D17 and actual owner deadlines constrain canonical draft bodies, citations/wording/mentions, attachment occurrences, editor Undo/local buffers, caches, exports, search and later published/notification derivatives. Draft save/read/restore does not extend native source lifetime. Preserve independently safe authored text only where its own lawful custody and qualified separation are established. Current stops apply even before cleanup/invalidation workers finish.

Unpublished private drafts and eventual published-note revisions remain separately qualified custody; no guessed 24-hour/30-day/forever policy is introduced. Actual draft/body/file/control horizons and restore barriers are mandatory activation evidence. Offboarding/reinvitation/email reuse does not hand another person the departed worker's draft. Authorized colleagues may continue the real source obligation in their own writing; exceptional records/privacy custody remains separately governed, not a general manager “see drafts” override. Backups restore source/terminal fences before replay access, and preserve truthful independently retained published/communication facts.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0015 — C11 — Storage, attachments and derived assets

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Reuse the existing qualified private attachment/reference owner. Bind selected files and upload occurrences to tenant, real owner, purpose, draft generation and current source, then to the admitted published note only during qualified Post. A filename, arbitrary URL, bucket name/path prefix or storage owner_id alone does not establish current source access. Reject unsupported or unsafe files; never reacquire assets from pasted external URLs during autosave or resume.

Qualify bucket privacy, storage.objects read/list/insert/update/delete policies, object identity, upload completion, preview conversion, download authorization and service-role routes. The general Storage examples are starting points, not sufficient private-draft policies. Upsert requires additional SELECT/UPDATE and can overwrite files; use immutable upload occurrences unless a legitimate replacement command independently qualifies that change. A private bucket supports authorized downloads or time-limited signed links, while public buckets bypass retrieval controls. A preissued signed URL is a time-bounded bearer capability, not proof of current membership on each use: satisfy D16's actual revocation barrier with the qualified guarded delivery route where needed, and test the issued-link case rather than promising instantaneous revocation from a policy change. Storage access control, bucket models

Post cannot silently omit attachments as current Note code does; pending/failed/ready state is explicit and actual postability is checked. Draft discard retires only draft-owned occurrences; it does not delete source/shared/published files by cascade. Blob cleanup is a reference-aware owner obligation outside the database admission transaction, recoverable by its exact identifier-only job. Local upload navigation follows D37's saved-text/unfinished-file guard; a manifest is not a cross-device copy of browser File bytes.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0016 — C12 — Finder projection, indexes and load

Applies to **US26-D38-01**, acceptance **AC26-D38-01-01–03**.

The same My drafts metadata query includes both qualified purposes with a clear Reply/Internal note label. Every row remains owned by one person and source, regardless of shared Open/Waiting/Resolved/assignment state. Purpose must be part of row/action/response identity so Enter restores the correct composer. No new Note-only destination, body preview/index, recipient/mention search or exact sidebar count is introduced.

Keep D37's title search, inbox scope, 20-row initial/50-row maximum requests and deterministic keyset pagination. Authorize all effective row/source/title rules before limiting; do not load full tenant histories or bodies and then filter. Support relevant `(tenant,owner,active lifecycle,meaningful_saved_at,id)` scan plus purpose-slot uniqueness and FK/dependency lookup indexes; optional purpose filtering must use actual plan evidence, not force a second unchosen UI filter. Constant identity functions may be statement-scoped; row-dependent source checks must not be cached once as though independent of the row. Record actual p50/p95, tenant/draft/source counts, payload maxima and concurrency profile; no new claimed throughput/latency SLO is inferred from vendor benchmarks.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0017 — C13 — Email Studio, P6, CRM and attention ownership

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Support owns private Note drafting, canonical publication, source permissions and the posted note's D35 history. Shared Tiptap/P17 authoring/schema/static-rendering capabilities may support that Note profile without creating an Email Studio reusable draft or prepared email. Ordinary Note save/open/restore/discard never executes P17 preparation or P6 delivery.

Actual Post may create the existing qualified D15 E3 published-note occurrence and optional-follow obligations once. Direct-mention attention is separately governed by its own qualified producer, not D15 optional-follow enrollment or Stop. Each notification owner applies current note/source/member/channel permissions and its own durable recipient identity. Follow Off/Stop cannot suppress required direct attention; mentioning someone cannot enroll them as a follower. Existing owner coalescing handles overlapping reasons without a new hand-built double-count rule. If an already-governed notice has an external email step, that separate complete notice uses P17 preparation and P6 dispatch; an in-product step follows ADR0032 prepared.none without provider bytes. Do not claim a posted internal note can never lead to any staff email, and do not send the private draft body as a notification.

CRM resumes the same currently authorized private Note draft/source and later shows the same permission-qualified published source. It gets no copied draft, private-body Activity, new contact/relationship, automatic record grant, financial mutation or completion assertion. This preserves shared context without a synchronization product. Draft privacy is owner-only, while a published Internal note has its own current permitted staff audience; these are intentionally distinct states and access rules.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0018 — C14 — Compatible rollout and repair

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Extend the qualified D37 owner by purpose only after all old raw writers and published-note shortcuts are inventoried and closed for this new path. Deploy compatible schema/constraints/readers/commands before note autosave and My drafts exposure. Older reply-only clients must not parse Note drafts as Reply, mutate purpose, drop unknown canonical nodes, expose metadata or recreate a retired generation.

Preserve reply data exactly; do not clone Reply fields/defaults into new Note purpose. Existing posted notes stay posted; do not backfill them into private drafts. Proven legacy unsent local material may enter the new owner only through an explicit currently qualified adoption command, never manufactured old authorship/times or HTML guessing. No automatic migration can recover unpersisted browser text after it is lost. Use idempotent migration mappings and restricted finite repair custody for ambiguous existing database rows. Kill switches disable affected new writes/exposure while leaving qualified safe read and accepted post/send/notification reconciliation intact. After new data exists, compatible roll-forward is preferred; rollback cannot reopen broad old CRUD or drop purpose/privacy/terminal fences.

### REQ26-D38-SUPABASE_CONTRACT-S0019 — C15 — Falsifiable release proof and operations

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Prove actual owner/purpose/source semantics across UI, the shared API owner, raw Data API, view/RPC/service paths, storage and applicable search/Realtime/export consumers. Tests include same owner in two tenants, two owners in one tenant, multiple memberships, profile/auth IDs deliberately distinct, anonymous Auth, admin without private-owner authority, revoked source, stale JWT, old writer, mixed versions and retired identities. Test both successful access and denied row/metadata/body/asset/result existence.

Required outcomes also include: one Reply plus one Note in the same slot; duplicate first-save race; full canonical note/mentions/files atomic save; one Post and first published revision despite lost response; purpose/key mismatch rejection; save/discard/Post contention; exact D10 merge/Undo destination; D17 first note admission once with old frontier unavailable; no alerts from autosave; one recoverable D15 E3/follow obligation after Post with independently qualified direct mentions; Follow Off/Stop not suppressing required attention and mentions not enrolling followers; no staff draft-history disclosure; RLS old/new permitted-row transformation denial; no public/signed-link attachment escape; indexed complete pagination; source-deadline/retention restore; and actual IME/attachment/navigation cases through the shared editor.

Use existing body-free operation correlation, typed failures and row-count/latency/collision evidence. Do not log draft JSON, note text, mention addresses, attachment filenames/URLs, tokens or raw database errors. Any acknowledged content loss, forbidden exposure, duplicate Post or false newest-Saved state is an activation blocker and containment event, not a monitored acceptable defect. Reuse D37 residual monitoring ownership for the now purpose-qualified draft path; the main D38 proof record should incorporate these cases without falsely treating this source review as execution.

### REQ26-D38-R01 — D38-R01 — Need, alternatives and scope

Applies to **US26-D38-01**, acceptance **AC26-D38-01-01–03**.

Automatically save and expose new unpublished Internal-note drafts privately through My drafts. This preserves interrupted existing composition; it introduces no notebook, shared drafting, approval, scheduled posting, CRM note feature or persistent editing of already posted notes. Do not add manual-save or local-only policy settings, and do not assume frequent long ministry notes or a new care-record workflow.

### REQ26-D38-R02 — D38-R02 — One finder, clear purpose

Applies to **US26-D38-01**, acceptance **AC26-D38-01-01–03**.

Extend D37's existing **My drafts** population to eligible own external Reply and new Internal note drafts. Keep the stable entry, all accessible inboxes and work states, metadata-only rows, title-only search, separate Inbox filter, recency ordering, Refresh and complete keyset pagination. Retain 20 initial rows and a maximum 50 per request across the combined population, not a separate quota for each purpose. Show textual **Reply** or **Internal note** in each row, alongside permitted conversation context and authoritative save time. No body/mention/recipient/file preview, total count, new type filter, note tab, badge, notification or destination is added. Helper text can read “Your private reply and note drafts across accessible inboxes.” An unavailable row cannot leak forbidden existence or stale CRM context.

### REQ26-D38-R03 — D38-R03 — Independent private identities

Applies to **US26-D38-01**, acceptance **AC26-D38-01-01–03**.

Use one qualified Support private-draft owner with a closed purpose distinction. Enforce at most one active draft per **tenant, trusted staff owner, immutable original conversation and purpose**. A Reply and a new Note may coexist without overwriting, consuming or converting each other. An old lifecycle cannot be resurrected after post/send/discard. Multiple original conversations combined by a merge may retain separate drafts of the same purpose; do not deduplicate by current root, assignee, email or CRM Party. A new general note normally begins/resumes the current continuing original's own Note slot; direct My drafts activation opens the exact selected private slot. No silent choice of someone else's or another original's writing.

### REQ26-D38-R04 — D38-R04 — Meaningful creation and complete preservation

Applies to **US26-D38-02**, acceptance **AC26-D38-02-01–03**.

Opening Internal note, focusing, selecting, hydration or loading defaults creates no durable draft. First meaningful author changes to the qualified body, note wording, typed mentions or file selection may create one. Preserve structurally valid incomplete work, including only a pending attachment; save readiness is separate from post readiness. An existing draft whose content is cleared remains until deliberate Discard or actual admission. Do not silently delete it or invent a title/body from CRM. Actual Add note requires meaningful canonical body **or at least one ready, clean, currently authorized selected attachment**. It must not require dummy “see attached” text; an empty note with no such file cannot post. Every selected unfinished, unsafe or invalid file must be repaired or deliberately removed before posting; it is never silently omitted.

### REQ26-D38-R05 — D38-R05 — Draft origin and actual note destination

Applies to **US26-D38-04**, acceptance **AC26-D38-04-01–03**.

Preserve the original conversation where private work began as its slot anchor. Separately qualify the **actual publication original** under D10-R14: a general note posted from a combined workspace attaches to the then-current continuing original, unless an existing authorized source-specific action establishes another original. Do not copy external Reply retargeting rules or create a new destination picker. If a merge/Undo changes destination or eligible internal audience after writing began, retain permitted work, explain the changed destination and obtain targeted review before Add note; routine unchanged notes require no extra confirmation. Recheck topology/source/privacy generations atomically at admission. A B-origin draft resumed after B joins A keeps its private B slot, while a reviewed general note posts under A. A post committed before Undo keeps its lawful original affinity; an Undo committed first forces current review. No silent rehoming, duplicate draft or automatic publication under the old anchor.

### REQ26-D38-R06 — D38-R06 — Quiet saving with truthful status

Applies to **US26-D38-04**, acceptance **AC26-D38-04-01–03**.

Reuse D37's qualified scheduling: attempt after **750 ms of quiet**, or by **5 seconds of eligible continuous input**, in the foreground/online/authorized/valid-schema/non-IME case with no unresolved prior save. These are scheduling targets, not network acknowledgment or crash-recovery guarantees. Each purpose-qualified controller has at most one save in flight and coalesces newer committed state. Do not let the Reply controller save or acknowledge Note content. Provide Save now/Retry save without requiring a manual save habit. **Saved** or **Saved privately** means the latest complete eligible local bundle is durably acknowledged. An old acknowledgment cannot mark later typing saved, reset it or alter the other mode. Quiet success must not produce repeated toast or screen-reader announcements.

### REQ26-D38-R07 — D38-R07 — Note-specific canonical profile

Applies to **US26-D38-02**, acceptance **AC26-D38-02-01–03**.

Keep the existing shared Tiptap/editor and versioned canonical schema, with the code-owned Internal note profile applied before parser normalization and again at server admission. Persist canonical structured body, qualified typed mention/wording/source references, note asset selection, locale/direction and explicit source/context/version identity. Exclude external To/Cc/Bcc, sender/signature/quote-delivery envelope, P17 preparation state and **D24 staged work plans**. D24 expressly excludes internal-note-and-work mode; the separate Reply plan remains intact. Do not execute typed fill-ins or mentions while saving. Incomplete allowed values can remain typed unresolved draft values; unknown nodes, unsupported attributes, executable HTML and forbidden sources cannot be “fixed” by silently stripping and saving them. No new editor, schema language, Tiptap Cloud, Yjs or history service is required.

### REQ26-D38-R08 — D38-R08 — Mentions remain inert until posting

Applies to **US26-D38-02**, acceptance **AC26-D38-02-01–03**.

Mention picker selection, insertion, removal, hydration, autosave, finder reads and restoration must produce **zero posted notes, timeline activity, attention intents or external messages**. Preserve each currently qualified mention as authoring data. At Add note, resolve distinct eligible targets from the admitted canonical version through the independently governed direct-mention producer; removed mentions never notify, and repeated chips do not produce duplicate attention for the same admitted occurrence. D15 separately owns optional-follow publication eligibility and its frontier. A mention never enrolls Follow, and optional-follow Off/Stop does not suppress an independently required direct mention; qualified overlap handling remains with the existing attention owners. Ineligible targets require an honest repair/removal path, not a newly inferred CRM recipient or privacy bypass. Existing attention eligibility, self-mention handling and channel policy remain with their owning contract. The current composer-to-activity helper path that POSTs a note on mention insertion must be closed before enabling this capability, not merely hidden in My drafts.

### REQ26-D38-R09 — D38-R09 — Files have private draft custody

Applies to **US26-D38-02**, acceptance **AC26-D38-02-01–03**.

A draft manifest references owner-qualified asset occurrences; it is not proof that browser File bytes uploaded or a file passed scanning. Upload through the approved Storage/asset path, with current draft tenant/author/source access on original and derivative reads. Ready, pending, failed, rejected and removed are honest per-file states. Raw bucket paths, MIME assertions and signed URLs are not authorization. Require existing D32 preview/scanning/source-stop controls. Posting atomically transfers or links exactly the selected permitted occurrences to the posted note's custody; discarding removes only draft-owned occurrences through qualified cleanup. Storage object operations and the SQL transaction are not one distributed transaction: durable cleanup/finalization obligations prevent lost effects and orphaned private uploads. A pending transfer cannot vanish on navigation while text claims complete recovery.

### REQ26-D38-R10 — D38-R10 — Trusted actor and intersected current access

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Authenticate through the existing Supabase server session and Core acting-context boundary. Derive real author/profile, tenant and applicable membership/capability from trusted context; input carries resource choices, not asserted ownership or approval. Actual source IDs are TEXT; profile/auth/membership identities are UUIDs with explicit real mappings. Each read/save/discard/post checks ownership plus its own current source and operation-specific authority. If only posting permission is lost while private read/custody remains valid, the eligible saved note may be inspected with Add note unavailable; ownership does not restore write/post authority. Posting additionally checks the actual current destination and every controlled dependency. Assignment, conversation participation, followers, CRM ownership, matching email or normal administrator status never grants colleague-draft access. Exceptional records/privacy custody uses D16/D17's separate narrow audited route, not a staff draft-browser feature. New CRM identity or relationship inference is not part of this command.

### REQ26-D38-R11 — D38-R11 — Structural database and authorization closure

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Apply the Supabase contract to the shared draft owner: non-null tenant/real owner/origin/purpose/lifecycle/revision/schema metadata, tenant-aware keys and foreign keys, purpose-qualified active uniqueness, immutable owner/source/purpose fields, valid lifecycle/terminal-reference checks, server timestamps, bounded canonical document and exact idempotency relationships. Purpose changes are forbidden updates. Derived HTML/text/list metadata is not another write authority. Base-table grants, RLS reads/mutations, functions, views, Storage and service-role paths must all preserve the same boundary. Evaluate both old-row `USING` and resulting-row `WITH CHECK` plus column/function authority. Ordinary clients must not update terminal/audit/owner/source fields or bypass multi-row admission through generic CRUD. Test all effective permissive policies and privileges, not only a newly added narrow policy. No financial/money column or new monetary calculation is introduced.

### REQ26-D38-R12 — D38-R12 — Atomic saves, concurrency and durable result identity

Applies to **US26-D38-04**, acceptance **AC26-D38-04-01–03**.

Save the entire note bundle and its accepted revision/result atomically through a shared API owner command and one qualified database transaction/RPC. Multiple browser `.from()` requests do not provide that atomicity. Match expected revision, immutable purpose, current tenant/owner/source/privacy and lifecycle generations. An unchanged canonical bundle is a no-op for edit time/revision but still has an exact operation result. Two tabs cannot silently overwrite; preserve a permitted losing candidate and let its author review/reapply against the new base. Bind each operation handle to exact actor/tenant/source/purpose/lifecycle/base and semantic command. An unknown acknowledgment recovers that same operation; absence is not nonacceptance until late admission is fenced. Returning an original result and reading today's draft state are distinct. No fresh-key retry or automatic content merge.

### REQ26-D38-R13 — D38-R13 — Mode switches, navigation and local work

Applies to **US26-D38-04**, acceptance **AC26-D38-04-01–03**.

Reply/Note switches preserve separate committed bodies, files, provenance and owner controllers. A late callback is scoped to its original identity/purpose and cannot write into the currently visible mode. Capture settled editor/IME state before changing its context; do not equate raw compositionend with a committed transaction. Keep supported CRM side context mounted where appropriate. Navigation that would destroy dirty work flushes the relevant retained controllers, including a dirty other purpose, without an unnecessary confirmation after routine success. Reuse one guard for known failure, unknown save and local pending File consequences. Permit informed Leave during unresolved saves without claiming they were canceled. Preserve body-free operation handles; no hidden offline body/file archive. On privacy/account/tenant loss, purge forbidden state and Undo even if the person had unsaved work. Browser crash/close remains best-effort, not guaranteed last-keystroke recovery.

### REQ26-D38-R14 — D38-R14 — Resume the same note with context

Applies to **US26-D38-04**, acceptance **AC26-D38-04-01–03**.

My drafts opens one exact currently authorized saved bundle into the existing Internal note composer. No temporary Reply-mode flash, default signature, new empty body or substitute CRM context. Show the current conversation and internal purpose before automatic desktop editing focus; on mobile reveal context before user-directed keyboard focus. Preserve the originating list query/filter/selection/scroll for same-session return. Cross-device recovery covers acknowledged content/context, not exact caret location. Newly inaccessible or incompatible content has a current-authority-safe unavailable/repair state; it is not presented as an empty draft. Changed destination/mentions/assets are review needs, not hidden automatic edits. Loading a draft does not reopen, assign, resolve, follow or satisfy a service target.

### REQ26-D38-R15 — D38-R15 — Add note is one authoritative admission

Applies to **US26-D38-03**, acceptance **AC26-D38-03-01–03**.

Deliberate Add note submits the newest settled candidate through the qualified Support owner. The person need not wait for a debounce or click Save first; the command may admit that exact final bundle atomically. It must settle/recover earlier dependent save operations before admitting against a known base. Under one transaction and common lock/version protocol, recheck source/destination/author/purpose/privacy, validate post readiness, admit one canonical native-human note and initial D35 history, admit selected file relationships, consume the exact draft generation, record the durable operation result and necessary source activity/attention outbox obligations. Roll back all database effects on failure. No provider I/O inside this transaction. Optimistic UI is pending until authoritative admission; reconcile one pending row to the actual note ID without duplicates. Posting never consumes the separate Reply draft/plan or means a CRM/giving action finished.

### REQ26-D38-R16 — D38-R16 — Unknown posting and downstream failure

Applies to **US26-D38-03**, acceptance **AC26-D38-03-01–03**.

The post operation has durable business-effect identity, not merely a request timeout key. A lost response may mean the note was already admitted. Freeze the affected post candidate while checking/recovering the original operation, preserving authorized navigation and honest status; do not offer a fresh editable draft/duplicate Add note to repair uncertainty. If posting committed, show the actual note and keep its draft terminal even when attention delivery or a later projection fails. Retry only the original downstream obligation under its own identity. A definite pre-admission rejection preserves the draft and repairable work. Note admission/consumption and source/privacy/merge transitions must share a proven concurrency boundary; two separately checked writes are insufficient. Duplicate suppression is per exact draft/post occurrence, not a heuristic that collapses legitimate separate notes from different staff or original slots.

### REQ26-D38-R17 — D38-R17 — Deliberate, purpose-specific discard

Applies to **US26-D38-04**, acceptance **AC26-D38-04-01–03**.

Reuse D37's single Discard confirmation, naming the **Internal note draft** and explaining that only that unfinished note and draft-owned attachments are removed. The conversation, posted notes and separate Reply remain. Discard checks the reviewed revision/generation and terminates it atomically with its result and cleanup obligations. Another tab's newer save conflicts rather than being deleted. A stale save cannot resurrect a discarded or posted generation. A possibly admitted Add note cannot be canceled through Discard; recover its original operation. No bulk discard, hidden trash, Undo timer, restore-history product or automatic draft transfer is introduced.

### REQ26-D38-R18 — D38-R18 — Privacy, retention and lifecycle ownership

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Private draft rows/bodies/derivatives/operation material obey current D16/D17 source and exceptional-custody rules. Autosave, last-edited sorting, reads and restore do not renew the original source lifetime or override a restrictive stop. Current read authorization applies to caches, signed access, search metadata, exports, logs and any optional realtime path. An admitted native-human note receives D17's actual posting/admission event and its proper native clock; draft creation is not a fabricated earlier note event. Required source-derived dependencies retain their stops; independent admitted evidence keeps its own qualified history rules. No silent age eviction or invented draft lifetime. Before activation, the existing owner inventory must explicitly cover note draft bodies, assets, terminal/result evidence, backup/export treatment, author departure and source deletion/archival, with no generic cascade that removes required history or restores forbidden material.

### REQ26-D38-R19 — D38-R19 — CRM continuity without duplicate ownership

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

CRM-hosted Support context uses the same canonical draft and eventual note under intersected current authority, preserving return navigation. The requester, message participant, authenticated author, profile, CRM Party/person/organization, assigned responder and CRM owner remain distinct. Shared/changed email and CRM merge do not reassign private writing. Links or read projections confer no right to read restricted missionary/member-care/giving records or update another domain. CRM activity may reference the one admitted Support occurrence through its existing contract; no draft activity and no duplicated note body as another authoritative CRM note. Financial, receipt, refund, recurring-gift and contact actions remain with their own permissions, validation, approvals and history; neither saving nor posting executes them.

### REQ26-D38-R20 — D38-R20 — Email Studio, Tiptap, Realtime and platform seam

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Support owns private persistence, discovery, current source/actor checks and actual note admission. The shared P17-governed canonical editor/profile and reusable wording may support authoring/validation; **a note save or note post is not an outgoing-email preparation or Email Studio template publication**. Any separately authorized internal attention notification produced after admission has its own P17 presentation and P6 delivery/reconciliation contract; in-product attention has no fabricated provider state. External Reply's P17 whole-message preparation and immutable P6 delivery remain unchanged. Supabase Postgres is durable storage; Realtime Presence/Broadcast is not saving or posting. No draft bodies/mentions/files on presence channels or automatic table-publication enrollment. The finder works through the approved bounded read model with invalidation/refetch; no new websocket server, poll-per-keystroke loop or realtime dependency is necessary. Vercel/Next.js request memory is not the durable owner.

### REQ26-D38-R21 — D38-R21 — Clear, restrained and accessible interface

Applies to **US26-D38-04**, acceptance **AC26-D38-04-01–03**.

Use shared Base UI primitives and exact base-maia geometry/semantic tokens. Show **Internal note** and “Private until you select Add note”; keep Add note distinct from Send and secondary Save now/Discard. Text, icon and accessible names convey purpose rather than color alone. Ordinary write/save/resume needs no modal. Reserve review/confirmation for an actual changed destination, unresolved loss risk, destructive discard or existing admission requirement. Do not animate or reorder under typing/focus, force mobile keyboards, obscure content behind status chrome or make a hover-only action essential. Verify 320 CSS-pixel reflow, 200% text resize, 400% zoom-equivalent reflow, keyboard/AT/IME, long names/Thai/RTL, local dates/zones, reduced motion, meaningful contrast and Core's 44 CSS-pixel touch target. These are required outcomes, not a claim that a specification alone proves perfect usability.

### REQ26-D38-R22 — D38-R22 — Bounded queries and responsive typing

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Do not load draft bodies or mount editors per row; fetch only the opened body's authorized representation. Keep editor transactions isolated from list rerenders. Index the tenant/owner/active-purpose population and stable meaningful-edit ordering, with tenant-aware source/dependency checks applied before pagination. Exclude control/cleanup timestamps from user recency. Scope query keys, request generations and cached results to real tenant/actor and source/purpose where applicable; stale responses cannot repopulate another context. Use D37's bounded scheduling/page limits and existing invalidation/focus/reconnect behavior. Do not duplicate status/count polling or invent exact latency claims. Qualify actual shared byte/node/depth/asset/query/concurrency and measured latency budgets before activation; record the workload and endpoint limits instead of assuming a vendor default proves capacity.

### REQ26-D38-R23 — D38-R23 — Migration, rollout and rollback

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Extend the qualified private owner/purpose contract through a compatible migration; do not store new drafts in today's broad published-note/message rows. Inventory every note producer, callback, renderer, Storage path, export, legacy writer and service-role route. Existing posted notes remain admitted evidence; do not reinterpret them as private drafts or invent historical draft authorship. Retained legacy private candidates require positive owner/source evidence; unknown cases use restricted repair custody. Deploy constraints/grants/commands/readers and initial note-history/asset/outbox admission first, then qualified editor/autosave and combined finder. Old clients must fail closed for unsupported purposes/schema/generations. Kill switches stop affected note-draft writes/exposure without discarding permitted local work, reviving terminal generations or canceling already admitted note/notification recovery. Use compatible roll-forward after new data exists; never roll back to the unsafe mention callback or broad writer.

### REQ26-D38-R24 — D38-R24 — Operational controls and audit

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Reuse existing operation telemetry and repair mechanisms with note-purpose outcome dimensions. No canonical body, mention names/addresses, filenames, signed URLs, tokens or full exception payloads in logs. Autosaves are not CRM activity, business history or staff-productivity records. Published note history and privacy/security audit retain separate owners. O01–O05 in the proof and operations record name signals, exact thresholds, responsible roles and responses. Privacy loss, premature publication, acknowledged-content loss, cross-purpose contamination and duplicate posting are release blockers and one-event containment triggers, never monitor-only concessions.

### REQ26-D38-R25 — D38-R25 — Resolve evidence and authority conflicts explicitly

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Replace broad staff/superadmin draft access with exact current private ownership and reviewed narrow commands. Preserve explicit intended old-row and resulting-row mutation checks, tenant composite keys, actual role/grant/view/function behavior and atomic note admission; generic helper or service-role behavior is not proof of authorization. The native Core CRM remains authoritative under the governing retirement of Twenty. Reconcile stale CRM backing/synchronization prose without reviving it or deleting the remaining identity, native-surface and permission requirements.

### REQ26-D38-R26 — D38-R26 — Proof and recording boundary

Applies to **US26-D38-05**, acceptance **AC26-D38-05-01–03**.

Require P01–P30 on actual qualified UI/editor/API/database/auth/storage/worker paths, extending the relevant D37 groups rather than rebuilding their tests as toy mirrors. Include adversarial roles, old/new schema, wrong-source/purpose callbacks, fast posting, unknown outcomes, topology/privacy races, CRM continuity, note assets/mentions, browser/IME/mobile/AT and intended-staff tasks. Preserve documentary checks, source-backed counterexamples and finite models as limited evidence.
